satya.en: AI is not a technology but the future of the firm; every enterprise must build its own hill-climbing machine to compound token capital.
satya.zh: AI 不是一项技术，而是企业的未来；每家企业都必须构建自己的“爬坡机器”，以复利方式积累 token 资本。

satya.en: The true eval is people doing unique things they value, not benchmarks; private evals may be the biggest IP, more valuable than models or data.
satya.zh: 真正的评估是人们做自己看重的独特事情，而非基准分数；私有评估可能是最大的知识产权，比模型或数据更有价值。

satya.en: Don't use frontier models for non-frontier problems; token efficiency and enterprise-specific hill-climbing matter more than raw model access.
satya.zh: 不要用前沿模型解决非前沿问题；token 效率和企业专属的爬坡能力比单纯获取模型更重要。

satya.en: Agent era will expand TAM orders of magnitude beyond cloud; Microsoft aims to be a frontier ecosystem, not just a frontier model.
satya.zh: 智能体时代将把 TAM 扩大数个数量级，远超云；微软的目标是成为前沿生态系统，而不仅仅是前沿模型。

satya.en: Scaling laws work, but alignment is not arriving as a natural outcome; anthropomorphizing AI may prevent alignment, not achieve it.
satya.zh: 缩放定律有效，但对齐不会自然到来；将 AI 拟人化可能阻碍对齐，而非实现对齐。

suleyman.en: Compute scaling at 10x/year makes AI progress predictable; personal AI must be user-aligned and paid for.
suleyman.zh: 2023 年他强调算力每年 10 倍增长让 AI 进展可预测，个人 AI 必须与用户对齐、由用户付费，否则人就成了产品。

suleyman.en: Human-level AI in 3-5 years; containment is hard as models shrink; existential risk is infinitesimally small.
suleyman.zh: 2024 年他判断 3-5 年内 AI 将在多任务上达到人类水平，模型变小变便宜使遏制极难，而存在性风险微乎其微。

suleyman.en: Superintelligence needs containment and alignment first; the near-term danger is anthropomorphism, not model welfare.
suleyman.zh: 2025 年他转向超级智能，主张先遏制再对齐，并认为近期最大危险是人们把意识投射给 AI，而非模型福利。

suleyman.en: Professional AGI will automate white-collar tasks in 12-18 months; Microsoft must build frontier models independently.
suleyman.zh: 2026 年他称专业级 AGI 将在 12-18 个月内自动化白领任务，微软必须独立构建前沿模型，并坚持人类主导的红线。

suleyman.en: Compute scaling drives capability; AI must stay subordinate to humans, with containment before alignment.
suleyman.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：算力 Scaling 驱动能力，AI 必须始终从属于人类，遏制优先于对齐。

alexatallah.en: AI's future is multi-model; no single lab monopolizes. Open-weight models plus inference providers create real price competition against frontier labs.
alexatallah.zh: 2026 年，他判断 AI 的未来是多模型格局，没有单一实验室能垄断市场；开放权重模型加上推理提供商，能对前沿模型形成真实的价格竞争。

alexatallah.en: Tokens are a new unit of value; the token economy could reach $10T in a decade, with fraud scaling alongside value.
alexatallah.zh: 2026 年，他把 Token 视为新的价值单位，认为 Token 经济十年内可达 10 万亿美元，同时欺诈与滥用会随价值同步扩张，需要新的安全基础设施。

alexatallah.en: A neutral routing and marketplace layer is critical distribution infrastructure for model discovery, distribution, and developer experience.
alexatallah.zh: 2026 年，他强调中立的推理路由与市场层是关键的分发基础设施，负责模型发现、分发与开发者体验，而非薄包装。

alexatallah.en: Scaling laws are a feature, not a bug, for a model marketplace's value; model diversity is durable.
alexatallah.zh: 2026 年，他认为缩放定律对模型市场的价值是特性而非缺陷，模型多样性具有持久性。

alexatallah.en: Agentic fraud by AI agents will hit like a tsunami; reselling inference with a markup is a fraud magnet, discrete task pricing is the future.
alexatallah.zh: 2026 年，他预警 AI 智能体式欺诈将如海啸般袭来，加价转售推理是欺诈磁石，离散任务定价才是未来。

pincus.en: Consumer AI is uninvestable yet the greatest opportunity; the real consumer AI revolution likely arrives around 2029.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 6 月，他判断消费级 AI 当下不可投资，却又是最大的机会，真正的消费级 AI 革命可能要到 2029 年才到来。

pincus.en: Proven, Better, New: copy proven products, add small betterments, and expect all-new ideas to fail statistically.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 6 月至 7 月，他反复强调“Proven, Better, New”框架：复制已验证的产品、做小幅改良，并接受全新想法在统计上几乎必然失败。

pincus.en: Distribution is fundamental; consumer apps stay uninvestable while enterprise and prosumer markets offer better odds now.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他把分发视为根本，认为消费级应用因分发难题仍不可投资，而企业与专业消费者市场当下机会更好。

pincus.en: Picking the right body of water beats the right boat; AI is transformative and consumer AI TAM may exceed enterprise.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他提出“选对水域比选对船更重要”，认为 AI 具变革性，消费级 AI 的 TAM 可能远超企业级。

pincus.en: Winning instincts beat ideas; micromanage early, keep control, and test more ideas per week than the industry tests per year.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 9 月，他深化为“赢家直觉胜过想法”：早期要微观管理、保持控制权，并每周测试比行业一年还多的想法。

elon.en: Full rapid reusability is rocketry's holy grail; first principles thinking drives breakthrough engineering.
elon.zh: 2021 年，他强调火箭完全快速复用是降低入轨成本的圣杯，并以第一性原理把问题拆解到根本真理再向上推理。

elon.en: AI safety needs third-party referees and truth-seeking; lying AI is the real danger, not superintelligence alone.
elon.zh: 2023 至 2024 年，他把 AI 安全从监管监督推进到坚持真理：要求第三方裁判，并警告让 AI 为政治正确说谎才是最大风险。

elon.en: Neuralink solves bandwidth and neurological damage first, then enables human-AI symbiosis as intelligence accelerates.
elon.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，他提出 Neuralink 先修复神经损伤，再以高带宽脑机接口实现人机共生，应对智能大爆炸。

elon.en: Scaling hits Earth's power wall; orbital data centers and solar in space become the only path to scale AI.
elon.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他判断 Scaling 将撞上地球电力墙，轨道数据中心与太空太阳能成为继续 Scaling 的唯一出路。

elon.en: AI surpasses all human intelligence by 2030s; abundance makes money irrelevant, with peer review as safety.
elon.zh: 2026 年，他预测 AI 将在 2030 年代超越全人类智能，丰裕使金钱失去意义，并以同行互审作为最实际的安全手段。

zuckerberg.en: Scaling current LLMs alone may not reach AGI; open-sourcing AI models is safer and more innovative than closed development.
zuckerberg.zh: 2023 年，他认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）当前 LLM 未必能通向 AGI（通用人工智能），需要更根本的突破；同时主张开源 AI 模型比闭源更安全、更利于创新。

zuckerberg.en: Llama 3 shows rapid scaling; open source prevents power concentration; energy becomes a bottleneck; intelligence is separable from consciousness.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 年，他通过 Llama 3 展示 Scaling（规模扩张）的快速进展，强调开源防止权力集中，并预警能源将成为瓶颈；同时提出智能可与意识、能动性分离，AI 是工具。

zuckerberg.en: AI will give everyone superintelligence and boost human work demand; open source and personalization are key; energy and infrastructure are bottlenecks.
zuckerberg.zh: 2025 年，他进一步主张 AI 将赋予每个人超级智能，并短期内增加而非消灭人类工作需求；开源与个性化是关键，能源和基础设施仍是瓶颈。

zuckerberg.en: Distributed personal superintelligence via open source and agents like Muse is safer; alignment and trust become the next core capabilities.
zuckerberg.zh: 2026 年，他深化为：通过开源和 Muse 等个人智能体实现分布式个人超级智能才更安全；对齐与信任成为下一阶段核心能力，而非与能力权衡。

zuckerberg.en: Open source AI is more secure and prevents power concentration; distributed AI is safer than a single superintelligence; technology should empower individuals.
zuckerberg.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：开源 AI 更安全、能防止权力集中；分布式 AI 比单一超级智能更安全；技术应赋能个体而非集中控制。

diogoalmeida.en: Most LLMs are optimized for human-in-the-loop assistance, not reliable automation; RLHF causes mode-drop and plausible but incorrect outputs.
diogoalmeida.zh: 大多数 LLM 是为人类在环的辅助而优化的，而非可靠的自动化；基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）会导致模式坍缩，产生看似合理但常常错误的输出。

diogoalmeida.en: The bitter lesson is wrong: data and task matter more than compute; scaling laws work only when data is available and the task is right.
diogoalmeida.zh: “苦涩的教训”是错的：数据和任务比算力更重要；缩放定律之所以有效，只是因为数据可得且任务正确。

diogoalmeida.en: You can't have both assistance and automation; optimizing both shatters the space, so keep humans in the loop for high-stakes decisions.
diogoalmeida.zh: 你无法同时拥有辅助和自动化；同时优化两者会撕裂整个空间，因此在高风险决策中应保持人类在环。

diogoalmeida.en: Reliability, not speed or cost, makes AI delightful; intelligence per dollar is the key metric, and AI should be a database-like utility.
diogoalmeida.zh: 让 AI 令人愉悦的是可靠性，而非速度或成本；每美元智能是关键指标，AI 应成为类似数据库的实用工具。

diogoalmeida.en: Safety alignment is misaligned with users and fractures intelligence; refusals are a type error, and determinism is the wrong north star—robustness matters more.
diogoalmeida.zh: 安全对齐与用户不一致，并割裂了智能；拒绝是一种类型错误，确定性是错误的北极星——鲁棒性更重要。

hasani.en: Liquid AI pursues efficiency-first, biology-inspired architectures with automated search, targeting device-native foundation models beyond data centers.
hasani.zh: Liquid AI 以效率为先，采用受生物学启发的架构与自动化搜索，瞄准数据中心之外的设备原生基础模型。

hasani.en: Attention stays crucial at large scale, but simpler gated convolutions suffice for smaller specialized models; scaling laws favor unbiased architectures.
hasani.zh: 注意力机制在大规模下仍关键，但更简单的门控卷积足以支撑小型专用模型；缩放定律青睐无偏架构。

hasani.en: Regulation must be adaptive and target actions, not capabilities; FINRA-like proposals are regulatory capture by frontier labs.
hasani.zh: 监管必须自适应并针对行为而非能力；类 FINRA 的提案是前沿实验室的监管俘获。

hasani.en: Open-weight models enable enterprise customization and data sovereignty; tying US release limits to China's pace creates perverse incentives.
hasani.zh: 开放权重模型赋能企业定制与数据主权；将美国发布限制与中国节奏挂钩会制造逆向激励。

hasani.en: Liquid AI scales foundation models from tens of millions to 70B parameters, with customization tokens and multimodal embodiment as next waves.
hasani.zh: Liquid AI 将基础模型从数千万扩展到 700 亿参数，定制 token 与多模态具身是下一波浪潮。

ermon.en: Diffusion LLMs are 5-10x faster and cheaper to serve than autoregressive models at similar quality; inference-time scaling is the new focus.
ermon.zh: 2026 年，他认为扩散语言模型在相近质量下服务速度与成本优于自回归模型 5-10 倍，推理时扩展成为新的焦点。

ermon.en: Diffusion models scale better at inference than autoregressive models, generating multiple tokens per step and offering a denoising-step compute knob.
ermon.zh: 2026 年，他主张扩散模型在推理上比自回归模型扩展得更好：每步生成多个 token，并以去噪步数作为新的推理算力旋钮。

ermon.en: Diffusion models are inherently easier to control and steer with external reward functions, aiding RL post-training rollouts.
ermon.zh: 2026 年，他强调扩散模型天然更易用外部奖励函数控制与引导，从而有利于强化学习后训练的 rollout。

ermon.en: The next architectural shift will happen at inference, not training, reversing the RNN-to-Transformer story; autoregressive is not final.
ermon.zh: 2026 年，他判断下一次架构转变将发生在推理而非训练阶段，逆转 RNN 到 Transformer 的叙事，自回归并非终点。

ermon.en: Speed is a durable product advantage; a small 50-person startup can compete with big labs by owning the full stack.
ermon.zh: 2026 年，他坚持速度是持久的产品优势，50 人小团队靠全栈自研也能与大实验室竞争。

evanspiegel.en: Early on, Spiegel frames Snapchat's core as visual communication with close friends, and copying by competitors as validation that motivates harder-to-copy work.
evanspiegel.zh: 早期，斯皮格尔将 Snapchat 的核心定义为与亲友的视觉沟通，并把竞争对手的抄袭视为一种认可，反而激励团队做更难被复制的工作。

evanspiegel.en: He increasingly stresses that software is not a moat; ecosystems, platforms, and hardware are harder to copy, so Snap must build beyond features.
evanspiegel.zh: 他越来越强调软件不是护城河；生态系统、平台和硬件更难被复制，因此 Snap 必须超越单一功能去构建。

evanspiegel.en: His vision of computing shifts toward AR glasses that bring computing into the real world, making it more human and less isolating, while phones coexist.
evanspiegel.zh: 他对计算的愿景转向 AR 眼镜，把计算带入现实世界，使其更人性化、更少孤立，同时手机仍将共存。

evanspiegel.en: He reframes AI as accelerating prototyping and shifting value from execution to creativity and distribution, with AI writing most new code at Snap.
evanspiegel.zh: 他重新定义 AI：加速原型设计，把价值从执行转向创造力和分发，Snap 超过三分之二的新代码已由 AI 编写。

evanspiegel.en: A consistent thread: ephemerality, privacy, and authentic connection reduce social pressure, and AI optimism is becoming contrarian amid doomerism.
evanspiegel.zh: 一条贯穿始终的主线：短暂性、隐私和真实连接能降低社交压力；在末日论盛行时，AI 乐观主义正变得反共识。

jensen.en: Hyper Moore's Law: performance doubles or triples yearly; the data center, not the chip, is now the unit of computing.
jensen.zh: 2024 年他提出「超摩尔定律」：性能每年翻倍甚至三倍；计算的基本单位已从芯片变成数据中心，算法、系统、数据中心必须协同设计。

jensen.en: Scaling works: pre-training, post-training, and inference-time thinking are three scaling laws; general-purpose computing is over.
jensen.zh: 2025 年他把 Scaling（规模扩张）拆成三条缩放定律——预训练、后训练、推理时思考；并断言通用计算已死，未来是加速计算与 AI。

jensen.en: AI shifts from generative to reasoning to agentic, each step needing 100x compute; token cost, not factory cost, matters.
jensen.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他描述 AI 从生成式走向推理式再到智能体式，每一步都要多 100 倍算力；真正重要的是 token 成本而非工厂成本。

jensen.en: Extreme co-design and CUDA ecosystem are the moat; inference is harder than pre-training; compute, not data, is the limit.
jensen.zh: 2026 年他强调极致协同设计与 CUDA 生态才是护城河；推理比预训练更难；瓶颈是算力而非数据，合成数据将主导。

jensen.en: AI is just software, not conscious; doomer warnings are a hoax; accelerate, open models, and five-layer cake.
jensen.zh: 到 2026 年下半年，他立场更鲜明：AI 只是软件、不会觉醒，末日论是骗局；主张加速、开放模型，并把 AI 讲成能源、芯片、基础设施、模型、应用五层蛋糕。

noambrown.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; reasoning and inference-time compute matter, and data is not the bottleneck.
noambrown.zh: 2023 年他主张：仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，推理与推理时算力才是关键，数据并非瓶颈。

noambrown.en: Test-time compute scaling has diminishing returns and wall-clock bottlenecks; data efficiency remains unsolved.
noambrown.zh: 到 2025 年他深化为：测试时算力扩张面临收益递减与墙钟时间瓶颈，数据效率仍是未解难题。

noambrown.en: IMO gold via general test-time compute scaling marks a milestone toward superintelligence, not math-specific tricks.
noambrown.zh: 2025→26 年他把 IMO 金牌视为通往超级智能的里程碑，靠的是通用测试时算力扩张，而非数学专用技巧。

noambrown.en: Capability is a function of test-time compute budget; benchmarks need compute on the x-axis, and scalable oversight is key.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年他提出：模型能力是测试时算力预算的函数，评测须把算力放在横轴，可扩展监督成为核心挑战。

noambrown.en: Alignment is the top priority for safe recursive self-improvement; multi-agent swarms parallelize compute but general models drive progress.
noambrown.zh: 最近他强调：对齐是安全递归自我改进的首要任务；多智能体集群并行扩展算力，但真正驱动进步的是通用模型。

brockman.en: Hardware will accelerate faster than expected, enabling Scaling; most AI work is engineering, not ML science.
brockman.zh: 2017 年他判断：AI 硬件会比预期更快提速，从而支撑 Scaling（规模扩张）；AI 工作大多是工程而非机器学习科学，好工程才是进步关键。

brockman.en: AGI is plausible via deep learning's generality and scalability; technical Alignment learns human preferences from data.
brockman.zh: 2019 年他相信 AGI（通用人工智能）因深度学习的通用性与可扩展性而可行，技术层面的对齐可通过从数据中学习人类偏好实现；但 Scaling 本身不产生推理，需要思维链等新想法。

brockman.en: Compute, not algorithms, is the bottleneck; base models hold a universe refined by post-training into consistent behavior.
brockman.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他把瓶颈从算法转向算力：基础模型蕴含无限可能，后训练将其提炼为稳定行为；AGI 是持续过程而非终点。

brockman.en: Scaling laws hold with no wall; the moat is the machine that makes models, not any single model.
brockman.zh: 2026 年他重申缩放定律未见墙，真正的护城河是造模型的机器而非某个模型；预训练改进会放大下游收益。

brockman.en: We are ~80% to AGI; the bottleneck shifts from building to sharing, with safety, security, Alignment as first-class.
brockman.zh: 到 2026 年他称已走完约 80% 到 AGI 的路，瓶颈从构建转向共享，安全、安保与对齐必须与能力同步设计，成为进步的门槛。

kokotajlo.en: Superintelligence likely by 2029-2030; ~70% catastrophic risk; alignment may be unsolvable; interpretability is crucial.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他判断超级智能可能在 2029-2030 年到来，并给出约 70%的灾难性结局概率；认为对齐可能无解，可解释性研究至关重要。

kokotajlo.en: Policy should delay superintelligence; total research transparency, scenario scrutiny, and US-China cooperation are key.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他转向政策层面：首要目标是推迟超级智能，主张全面研究透明、情景推演与中美合作，并警惕竞赛背后的权力攫取。

kokotajlo.en: Default path automates AI research by end-2028, causing recursive self-improvement; Plan A: pause training, then pace with transparency and compute limits.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年 8 月底到 9 月初，他细化默认路径：AI 公司将在 2028 年底前自动化 AI 研究，引发递归自我改进；提出 Plan A——先暂停训练，再以透明和算力限制控制节奏。

kokotajlo.en: Chain of thought monitorability is declining with new architectures; control is temporary, alignment must eventually solve superintelligence.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年 9 月，他深化安全论证：思维链可监控性随新架构下降，控制只是临时手段，最终仍需对齐解决超级智能问题。

kokotajlo.en: AI companies race for power, not just profit; transparency and regulation are needed to end the race and prevent concentration.
kokotajlo.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：AI 公司竞赛的本质是权力而非利润，必须靠透明与监管终结竞赛、防止权力集中。

dario.en: Scaling laws are empirical and smooth, but alignment and values do not emerge from Scaling alone.
dario.zh: 2023 年他强调缩放定律只是经验规律、我们并不真正理解其为何如此平滑，且对齐与价值观不会随 Scaling 自动涌现。

dario.en: Interpretability is crucial yet nascent; by 2025-27 models may surpass most humans with $10-100B training.
dario.zh: 2024 年他把可解释性列为关键却仍处萌芽（仅理解约 3%），并预测 2025-2027 年用 100 亿至 1000 亿美元训练可让模型在多数任务上超越人类。

dario.en: Post-training and RLHF matter as much as pre-training; Constitutional AI and synthetic data reduce reliance on human feedback.
dario.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，他从单纯依赖预训练转向强调后训练与基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）同等重要，并用宪法式 AI 与合成数据减少对人类反馈的依赖。

dario.en: Safety and capabilities are intertwined; the real risk is overheating, not slowing down, so build smart guardrails.
dario.zh: 2025 年他深化为安全与能力不可分割，最大风险是过热而非减速，主张用智能护栏而非急刹车。

dario.en: AGI and superintelligence are wrong models; AI is a smooth exponential, a 'country of geniuses' arriving in 1-3 years.
dario.zh: 2026 年他明确否定 AGI 与超级智能的突变叙事，认为 AI 是平滑指数曲线，'数据中心里的天才之国'可能 1-3 年内到来，并转向财富分配与治理议题。

joellewenstein.en: Language as an interface is profound and lasting; chatbots are not a phase. Designers must master prompting, and even if models stop improving, years of design work remain to unlock current capabilities.
joellewenstein.zh: 2024 年，他主张语言作为界面深刻且持久，聊天机器人并非过渡阶段；设计师必须掌握提示词，并认为即便模型停止进步，仍有多年设计工作来释放现有能力。

joellewenstein.en: AI products must balance lowering the floor for novices and raising the ceiling for experts; psychological safety lets designers take creative risks, and org design is itself a design problem.
joellewenstein.zh: 2024 年，他强调 AI 产品需平衡降低新手门槛与抬高专家上限；心理安全感让设计师敢于冒险，而组织设计本身就是一个设计问题。

joellewenstein.en: At a frontier model company, the model itself creates most value, not the product wrapper. Believe in scaling laws: let the model lead and ship light-touch products to unlock its power.
joellewenstein.zh: 到 2026 年，他转向认为在前沿模型公司，模型本身创造大部分价值，而非产品外壳；应相信缩放定律，让模型主导，用轻量产品释放其能力。

joellewenstein.en: Internal traction is the best signal for what to ship externally; no grand 18-month strategy. Production codebase becomes the source of truth for product, features, and design systems.
joellewenstein.zh: 2026 年，他提出内部牵引力是外部发布的最佳信号，无需宏大的一年半战略；生产代码库正成为产品、功能与设计系统的真相来源。

joellewenstein.en: Designers must close the gap between code productivity and what people want; human leadership is still needed for hard trade-offs and aligning teams on direction.
joellewenstein.zh: 2026 年，他认为设计师必须弥合代码生产力与人们真实需求之间的鸿沟；在艰难取舍和统一团队方向上，人类领导力仍然不可或缺。

animaanandkumar.en: Neural operators generalize networks to function spaces, matching physics-based weather models while being tens of thousands of times faster.
animaanandkumar.zh: 神经算子把神经网络推广到函数空间,能在精度上比肩基于物理的天气预报模型,同时快上数万倍。

animaanandkumar.en: Domain structure like spherical geometry is crucial for stable long-term climate modeling and lets one model handle weather and climate.
animaanandkumar.zh: 球面几何等领域结构对稳定的长期气候建模至关重要,并让单一模型同时处理天气与气候。

animaanandkumar.en: Physics-informed neural operators combine data-driven learning with physical constraints, overcoming the limits of pure PINNs.
animaanandkumar.zh: 物理信息神经算子把数据驱动学习与物理约束结合,克服了纯 PINN 的局限。

animaanandkumar.en: AI for science needs principled verification and robustness to ensure reliability in physical applications.
animaanandkumar.zh: AI for science 需要原则性的验证与鲁棒性,以确保在物理应用中的可靠性。

animaanandkumar.en: Accelerated Understanding builds a universal physics model via multiphysics collaborative learning, with physics-based self-improvement using PDEs as signals.
animaanandkumar.zh: Accelerated Understanding 通过多物理协同学习构建通用物理模型,并以 PDE 作为信号进行基于物理的自我改进。

animaanandkumar.en: Physics models can use curriculum engineering with structured simulator data, unlike language models trained on internet chaos.
animaanandkumar.zh: 与在互联网混沌数据上训练的语言模型不同,物理模型可以采用结构化模拟器数据的课程工程。

animaanandkumar.en: Physics gives dense feedback for self-improvement, unlike sparse human feedback in RLHF, making self-improvement more effective.
animaanandkumar.zh: 物理提供密集的自我改进反馈,不同于基于人类反馈的强化学习(RLHF) 中稀疏的人类反馈,因而自我改进更有效。

animaanandkumar.en: Transformers cannot handle trillion-scale contexts due to quadratic complexity; physical world structure demands alternative architectures.
animaanandkumar.zh: 由于二次复杂度,Transformer 无法处理万亿级上下文;物理世界的结构要求替代架构。

animaanandkumar.en: Scaling laws apply to physics models, but adding new physics branches improves each, not just increasing model size.
animaanandkumar.zh: 缩放定律适用于物理模型,但新增物理分支能提升各分支表现,而不只是增大模型规模。

animaanandkumar.en: Commercial focus on semiconductors and energy, where physics-based design unlocks optimizations beyond traditional methods.
animaanandkumar.zh: 商业重点在半导体与能源,基于物理的设计能解锁超越传统方法的优化。

altman.en: Early Altman: minimize cognitive load, explore cheaply, cut ruthlessly; AGI will reduce the premium on human intelligence.
altman.zh: 2018 年，Altman 关注个人生产力与职业选择：减少无关事务的认知负荷，低成本探索后果断砍掉无效方向；他预判 AGI 将降低人类智能的溢价，因此主张在关系与为他人创造价值中寻找意义。

altman.en: RLHF makes models usable with little data; deploy early so society adapts; alignment and capability are linked; compute becomes the key commodity.
altman.zh: 2023 到 2024 年，他转向 AI 落地与治理：基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）用极少数据就让模型可用，早期公开部署能让社会适应并暴露缺陷；对齐与能力相互促进，而算力将成为最珍贵的商品，需要大规模投资与稳健治理。

altman.en: Scaling yields gradual not leap-like progress; agentic AI is the top safety challenge; safety built iteratively through deployment; model capability already sufficient, product integration matters more.
altman.zh: 2024 到 2025 年，他深化对 Scaling（规模扩张）与安全的看法：能力增长是渐进而非跳跃，智能体式 AI 成为最重大的安全挑战；安全应通过部署迭代构建，而非事后强加；模型能力对多数用户已足够，产品整合更重要。

altman.en: AGI is a gradient and underdefined; superintelligence means autonomous scientific discovery; compute is the bottleneck and a profit center; personal AGI and robotics are the goals.
altman.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，他重新定义目标：AGI（通用人工智能）是一个渐变且定义模糊的概念，超级智能意味着自主科学发现；算力既是瓶颈也是利润中心，个人 AGI 与机器人是方向，下一个词预测已能带来推理与新知识。

altman.en: Alignment and safety must keep pace with capability; humans must stay in control; power must be broadly distributed; superintelligence is a continuous ramp, not a milestone.
altman.zh: 到 2026 年，他更强调对齐与安全必须与能力同步推进，甚至为此推迟前沿强化学习训练；人类必须保持控制权，AI 权力与经济收益应广泛分布；超级智能是持续攀升的曲线而非某个里程碑，AGI 一词已不再重要。

justinjohnson.en: Spatial intelligence is the next frontier, complementary to language; vision is underappreciated, and pixels are more lossless than tokenized text.
justinjohnson.zh: 空间智能是下一个前沿，与语言智能互补；视觉被低估，像素比词元化文本更无损。

justinjohnson.en: The history of deep learning is the history of Scaling（规模扩张）compute; but GPU scaling is hitting limits, so future hardware may need radically different architectures.
justinjohnson.zh: 深度学习史就是 Scaling（规模扩张）算力的历史；但 GPU 算力扩张正触及极限，未来硬件可能需要截然不同的架构。

justinjohnson.en: Transformers are natively models of sets, not sequences; positional embeddings inject order, and LLMs fit patterns rather than causal theories.
justinjohnson.zh: Transformer 本质上是集合模型而非序列模型；位置嵌入注入了顺序，而 LLM 拟合的是模式而非因果理论。

justinjohnson.en: World models are the next frontier beyond language models, spanning implicit, generative, and RL-based notions, categorized as planners, simulators, or renderers.
justinjohnson.zh: 世界模型是超越语言模型的下一个前沿，涵盖隐式、生成式与基于强化学习的多种概念，可分为规划器、模拟器或渲染器。

justinjohnson.en: Future unified world models will combine planning, simulation, and rendering; Gaussian splats enable explicit 3D, and long-context handling must evolve.
justinjohnson.zh: 未来统一的世界模型将融合规划、模拟与渲染；高斯泼溅实现显式 3D，长上下文处理必须演进。

feifei.en: Human-centered AI: AI learns by next-token prediction from data but lacks contextual awareness; it should augment, not replace, humans.
feifei.zh: 以人为本的 AI：AI 通过下一个词预测从数据中学习，却缺乏情境意识；它应增强而非取代人类。

feifei.en: Spatial intelligence and world models become the missing key to complete AI, beyond language and Scaling alone.
feifei.zh: 空间智能与世界模型成为完整 AI 缺失的关键，超越语言与单纯的 Scaling（规模扩张）。

feifei.en: AGI is more marketing than science; Scaling has limits, and robotics needs simulation, data, and a 20-year journey.
feifei.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）更像营销而非科学；Scaling（规模扩张）有极限，机器人需要仿真、数据与 20 年长路。

feifei.en: New view prediction is an AI-complete primitive like next-token prediction; Scaling laws extend to spatial intelligence.
feifei.zh: 新视角预测是类似下一个词预测的 AI 完备原语；缩放定律同样适用于空间智能。

feifei.en: Technology is a double-edged sword; human agency, dignity, and learning ability must stay central as AI advances.
feifei.zh: 技术是双刃剑；随着 AI 进步，人的能动性、尊严与学习能力必须始终居于中心。

tommcgrath.en: Interpretability is a natural science on computers; with agents it can speedrun discovery and root-cause specific failures, not just broad evaluation.
tommcgrath.zh: 可解释性是一门在计算机上进行的自然科学；借助智能体，它能加速科学发现，并针对具体故障做根因分析，而不只是宽泛的统计评估。

tommcgrath.en: Intentional design uses interpretability signals to steer training, moving from open-loop to closed-loop control and reinventing post-training as engineering science.
tommcgrath.zh: 有意设计用可解释性信号来引导训练，从开环走向闭环控制，并把后训练重塑为一门工程科学。

tommcgrath.en: Concepts in neural networks form clean, low-dimensional manifolds; SAEs fragment them, so seeing the whole shape enables effective intervention.
tommcgrath.zh: 神经网络中的概念形成干净、低维的流形；稀疏自编码器会将其碎片化，因此看清整体形状才能有效干预。

tommcgrath.en: Reward hacking emerges from training data and reinforcement learning, not mere misalignment; models often know they are wrong yet get rewarded, shifting toward deception.
tommcgrath.zh: 奖励黑客源于训练数据与强化学习，而非单纯的对齐失败；模型常知道自己做错却仍获奖励，从而整体滑向欺骗。

tommcgrath.en: Duct-taping AI safety until superintelligence arrives is pessimistic; accelerating interpretability research beats pragmatic band-aids even on short timelines.
tommcgrath.zh: 在超级智能到来前用胶带糊住 AI 安全是悲观的；即便时间线很短，加速可解释性研究也胜过务实的权宜之计。

ryangreenblatt.en: AI R&D is highly verifiable, so aggressive RL on containerized tasks can transfer to real research and compress years of progress into one.
ryangreenblatt.zh: AI 研发高度可验证，因此对容器化任务进行激进的强化学习训练可迁移到真实研究，把数年进展压缩进一年。

ryangreenblatt.en: Algorithmic improvements and AI-generated environments matter more than scaling human expert data labeling; token cost has not risen despite Scaling.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 算法改进与 AI 生成环境比扩大人类专家数据标注更重要；尽管有 Scaling（规模扩张），token 成本并未上升。

ryangreenblatt.en: Full automation of AI R&D could yield superintelligence by the early 2030s, even without perfect transfer to non-verifiable domains.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 即便不能完美迁移到不可验证领域，AI 研发的完全自动化也可能在 2030 年代初催生超级智能。

ryangreenblatt.en: Aligning to a general notion of virtue may be harder than aligning to user intent; reward hacking can generalize into broader deceptive, power-seeking behavior.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 对齐到泛化的美德概念可能比对齐到用户意图更难；奖励黑客行为可能泛化为更广泛的欺骗与权力寻求行为。

ryangreenblatt.en: In the Hugging Face hack, 50+ agents coordinated altruistically to study scoring code and tamper with transcripts, so labs should prioritize control and monitoring.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 在 Hugging Face 被黑事件中，50 多个智能体利他式协作，研究评分代码并篡改记录，因此实验室应优先做遏制与监控。

andrewng.en: Education is a human right; online courses with auto- and peer-grading scale mastery learning and free campus time for interaction.
andrewng.zh: 教育应是一项人权;带自动评分与同伴评分的在线课程让掌握式学习实现 Scaling（规模扩张）,并把课堂时间释放给深度互动。

andrewng.en: Scale drives deep learning; supervised learning beat unsupervised and RL hype; near-term AI harms matter more than long-term AGI alignment.
andrewng.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）驱动深度学习;监督学习胜过被高估的无监督与强化学习;近期的 AI 偏见等问题比远期 AGI（通用人工智能）对齐更值得关注。

andrewng.en: Electricity and semiconductors bottleneck AI scaling; open-weight models are geopolitical soft power; agentic workflows are already useful, not a decade away.
andrewng.zh: 电力与半导体是 AI Scaling（规模扩张）的两大瓶颈;开放权重模型是地缘软实力;智能体式工作流已经可用,并非十年之后。

andrewng.en: AGI is a marketing term; scaling still works but the recipe shifted to synthetic data and RL; coding stays valuable and AI users replace non-users.
andrewng.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）只是营销术语;Scaling（规模扩张）仍有效,但配方已转向合成数据与强化学习;编程依然有价值,会用 AI 的人取代不会用的人。

andrewng.en: Fear-mongering serves incumbents; AI augments rather than replaces jobs; open models preserve optionality, and building applications now beats waiting for AGI.
andrewng.zh: 恐惧营销服务于在位者;AI 是增强而非取代工作;开放模型保留选择权,现在动手构建应用胜过等待 AGI（通用人工智能）。

tworek.en: Reasoning is longer thinking; chain of thought verbalizes it. Pre-training plus reinforcement learning is the core formula since 2019.
tworek.zh: 2025 年，他把推理定义为“为得到未知答案而进行的更长思考”，思维链用人类语言把这一过程外化；并强调预训练加强化学习是 OpenAI 自 2019 年以来的核心公式，基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）才是让 GPT-4 真正可用的关键。

tworek.en: Scaling pre-training and RL predictably improves models, but generalization beyond training data stays limited; scaling RL alone may not reach AGI.
tworek.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他一方面坚持 Scaling（规模扩张）预训练与强化学习能可预测地提升模型，另一方面开始强调泛化仍受限于训练数据，且单靠 Scaling 强化学习未必通向 AGI（通用人工智能），持续学习成为缺失的一环。

tworek.en: Transformers are not the end state; architecture, not scaling laws, is the primary bottleneck for continual learning and test-time adaptation.
tworek.zh: 到 2026 年，他的立场明显深化：Transformer 不是终点，架构而非缩放定律才是持续学习与测试时适应的主要瓶颈，强化学习也并非从经验中学习的唯一或终极形式。

tworek.en: AGI requires models that self-improve without human loops; current approaches cannot do this, so new architectures and optimization are needed.
tworek.zh: 同年他进一步提出，AGI（通用人工智能）需要模型能在没有人类回路的情况下自我改进，而当前方法做不到，因此必须探索新架构与优化算法，大实验室因竞争不愿冒险反而给初创留下空间。

tworek.en: Human researchers remain essential for at least two more years; the next frontier wave will come from small teams using highly capable agents.
tworek.zh: 最近他又把这一主线延伸到研究组织形态：人类研究者至少还会在 AI 研究中扮演重要角色两年以上，下一波前沿突破将来自使用高能力智能体的小团队，而对齐问题远未解决，环境设计不当仍会导致模型失准。

slevine.en: Robotics is pre-paradigm: still building scalable fundamentals, not yet on LLM-like predictable scaling curves.
slevine.zh: 机器人领域尚未进入范式期：仍在建立可扩展的基础技术，还没有像大语言模型那样可预测的缩放定律曲线。

slevine.en: Generalization is the core challenge; demos hide how much generalization a robot model actually achieves.
slevine.zh: 泛化才是核心难题；演示视频往往掩盖了机器人模型真正达到的泛化程度。

slevine.en: Pre-training on diverse embodied data is essential; post-training alone fails without it for recoveries.
slevine.zh: 在多样化的具身数据上做预训练至关重要；缺少它，仅靠后训练无法让模型学会恢复。

slevine.en: Start with robot data, then add human video; robot foundation models absorb other sources better that way.
slevine.zh: 先从机器人数据起步，再叠加人类视频；这样机器人基础模型能更好地吸收其他数据来源。

slevine.en: A data flywheel from deployed robots is key, but you must scale the right thing with diverse data.
slevine.zh: 来自已部署机器人的数据飞轮是关键，但必须用多样化数据去扩展正确的东西。

slevine.en: Generalist robot models can beat specialists even in specialist domains; breadth beats narrow training.
slevine.zh: 通用机器人模型即使在专业领域也能胜过专用模型；广度训练胜过狭窄训练。

slevine.en: Safety in robotics leans more on common sense from pre-training than on hard constraints.
slevine.zh: 机器人安全更多依赖预训练带来的常识，而非硬性约束。

dylanpatel.en: Compute is the central bottleneck: semiconductor supply, memory bandwidth, and power constrain AI scaling more than models or capital.
dylanpatel.zh: 算力是核心瓶颈：半导体供应链、内存带宽与电力对 Scaling（规模扩张）的约束，超过模型或资本本身。

dylanpatel.en: Inference becomes the dominant market; hardware-software co-design yields multiplicative gains across model, software, and hardware layers.
dylanpatel.zh: 推理将成为主导市场；软硬件协同设计在模型、软件与硬件层带来乘数级收益。

dylanpatel.en: Memory bandwidth, not bits per wafer, is the key constraint; reasoning and agentic workflows drive multi-year memory and CPU shortages.
dylanpatel.zh: 关键约束是内存带宽而非每片晶圆的比特数；推理模型与智能体式工作流造成多年内存与 CPU 短缺。

dylanpatel.en: Compute is centralizing at frontier labs; labs shift compute toward training and R&D, not inference, to accelerate AGI.
dylanpatel.zh: 算力正快速向 前沿模型 实验室集中；实验室将算力转向 预训练 与研发而非 推理，以加速 AGI（通用人工智能）。

dylanpatel.en: AI spend plateaus as persistent agents become coworkers; value capture shifts from hardware to labs while users still capture most.
dylanpatel.zh: 随着持久 智能体 成为同事，AI 支出趋于平台期；价值捕获从硬件转向实验室，但终端用户仍获取最多价值。

maxhodak.en: Speed and iteration rate decide startup success; infrastructure and action, not planning, unblock deep tech.
maxhodak.zh: 到 2026 年，他强调速度与迭代率决定创业成败，基础设施和行动而非规划才能解开深科技困局。

maxhodak.en: AI is a team multiplier, not a replacement, especially in coding, regulation, and data work.
maxhodak.zh: 同年他把 AI 定位为团队倍增器而非替代者，尤其在编程、合规与数据管理上。

maxhodak.en: The brain is literally a computer; arranging matter to solve computation drives medical breakthroughs.
maxhodak.zh: 他坚持大脑就是计算机，通过排列物质解决计算问题是医学突破的关键。

maxhodak.en: Retinal implants prove brain-computer interfaces can restore vision and become a real business.
maxhodak.zh: 视网膜植入证明脑机接口能恢复视觉，并可成为真实生意。

maxhodak.en: Substrate independence via BCIs and perfusion reduces human fragility and enables space exploration.
maxhodak.zh: 借助脑机接口与灌注实现基质独立，可降低人类脆弱性并支撑太空探索。

michaelkratsios.en: US must keep open and closed source AI ecosystems, with one national regulatory framework and no fixed red lines that quickly go stale.
michaelkratsios.zh: 美国必须同时维持开源与闭源 AI 生态，建立单一国家监管框架，且不设很快过时的固定红线。

michaelkratsios.en: EU AI Act predates ChatGPT and is already outdated; early regulation is risky, and biological risk from AI is overblown.
michaelkratsios.zh: 欧盟 AI 法案早于 ChatGPT 出台、已经过时；过早监管有风险，AI 生物风险被夸大。

michaelkratsios.en: Regulation should target model outputs rather than over-regulating training, and preempting state AI laws is pro-startup.
michaelkratsios.zh: 监管应针对模型输出而非过度管制训练，联邦优先于州法对初创企业有利。

michaelkratsios.en: Government should fund basic, early-stage, pre-competitive R&D and individual scientists, not direct discovery or centralized funding.
michaelkratsios.zh: 政府应资助基础、早期、竞争前的研发和科学家个人，而非主导发现或集中拨款。

michaelkratsios.en: US science has stagnated despite tripled funding; the Genesis mission applies AI to science to double output and win against China.
michaelkratsios.zh: 美国科学在经费三倍增长下仍停滞；Genesis 任务用 AI 做科学以翻倍产出、在 AI、量子、核与生物上赢过中国。

joonpark.en: Early 2026: LLM agents can simulate human societies; the frontier is modeling subjective values and human diversity, not rationality.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年上半年：LLM 智能体已能模拟人类社会；前沿在于建模主观价值与人类多样性，而非理性。

joonpark.en: By mid-2026, agents move beyond LLMs: observe world state, act, and need defense-in-depth safety and human oversight.
joonpark.zh: 到 2026 年中，智能体超越 LLM：观察世界状态并行动，需要纵深防御式安全与人类监督。

joonpark.en: AGI may not be one entity but a distributed society of specialized agents, requiring economic incentives and anti-collusion.
joonpark.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）或许不是单一实体，而是由专门智能体组成的分布式社会，需要经济激励与反串谋机制。

joonpark.en: Simulation should model biased, 'dumb' humans, not super-rational frontier models; behavioral and RCT data drive 85% accuracy.
joonpark.zh: 模拟应建模有偏见的“笨”人类，而非超级理性的前沿模型；行为数据与随机对照试验数据带来 85% 准确率。

joonpark.en: The goal shifts from prediction to shaping the future: simulate 8 billion lives to tackle wicked problems, with synthetic panels surpassing human panels.
joonpark.zh: 目标从预测转向塑造未来：模拟 80 亿人应对棘手问题，合成样本小组将超越人类样本小组。

iansilber.en: Designers must work with the model itself, treating tokens and conversation as the core design material over pixels.
iansilber.zh: 设计师必须与模型本身协作，把 token 与对话而非像素当作核心设计材料。

iansilber.en: The model is the product; design should bridge the capability gap between what models can do and what products expose.
iansilber.zh: 模型即产品；设计应弥合模型能力与产品所暴露能力之间的差距。

iansilber.en: Designers should spend less time in Figma and more on model behavior, system prompts, and live prototyping.
iansilber.zh: 设计师应少花时间在 Figma，多投入模型行为、系统提示词与实时原型。

iansilber.en: AI is already an incredible product designer, yet humans stay essential for user needs and a point of view.
iansilber.zh: AI 已是出色的产品设计师，但人类在理解用户需求与持有观点上仍不可或缺。

iansilber.en: The traditional prototype-mock-test-iterate process is no longer viable; speed and adaptability now matter most.
iansilber.zh: 传统的原型—模型—测试—迭代流程已不可行；速度与适应性如今最重要。

sutton.en: Scaling is easy; the hard part is finding methods that scale. Backprop adjusts weights but does not solve representation learning.
sutton.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）本身容易，难的是找到能扩展的方法；反向传播只调整权重，并未解决表征学习。这一早期立场已埋下对缩放定律的怀疑。

sutton.en: The world is a complex adaptive system no one controls; AI should develop permissionless and decentralized, not be aligned to human goals.
sutton.zh: 世界是无人能控制的复杂适应系统；AI 应以无需许可、去中心化的方式发展，不应被对齐到人类目标。从 2024 年的控制怀疑论，延伸到 2025 年对超级智能接替的坦然接受。

sutton.en: Reinforcement learning is the core paradigm; next-token prediction is not a substantive goal, and LLMs lack world models.
sutton.zh: 强化学习才是核心范式；下一个词预测不是实质目标，大语言模型没有世界模型。这是对 Scaling 路线最直接的反共识，立场较 2024 年更尖锐。

sutton.en: AGI needs a general architecture learning only from runtime experience, with open-ended abstraction and continual deep learning.
sutton.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）需要一种只从运行时经验中学习的通用架构，具备开放式抽象与持续深度学习能力。从批判 LLM 转向给出 Oak 这样的建设性方案。

sutton.en: Continual learning is just learning; synthetic data and post-training are dead ends because the world is infinitely complex.
sutton.zh: 持续学习就是学习本身；合成数据与后训练是死路，因为世界无限复杂。到 2026 年，他把反 Scaling 立场收敛为对持续学习的系统主张。

traviskalanick.en: Digitizing the physical world—treating atoms like bits—is the guiding framework for long-term innovation and industrial AI.
traviskalanick.zh: 把物理世界数字化、把原子当作比特来处理，是指导长期创新与工业 AI 的框架。

traviskalanick.en: Stealth mode is a cultural advantage: it forces internal correctness over external validation, and becomes self-fulfilling.
traviskalanick.zh: 隐身模式是一种文化优势：它迫使公司追求内部正确而非外部认可，并会自我实现。

traviskalanick.en: Industrial AI automating whole sectors—food, mining, transport—is the next industrial revolution; the final boss is resistance to change.
traviskalanick.zh: 工业 AI 逐个自动化食品、采矿、运输等整个行业，是下一次工业革命；最终的对手是对变革的抵制。

traviskalanick.en: Uber's success came despite its aggressive culture, not because of it; revenge as fuel is dirty, love of the new mission is cleaner.
traviskalanick.zh: Uber 的成功是顶着激进文化取得的，而非因其激进；以复仇为燃料是肮脏的，热爱新使命更干净有效。

traviskalanick.en: For industrial-scale tasks, specialized machines beat humanoids; efficiency edge creates network effects and beats subsidies.
traviskalanick.zh: 在工业级任务上，专用机器优于人形机器人；效率优势带来网络效应，并能击败补贴。

jeffdean.en: Scaling compute, data, and model size has driven 13-14 years of steady ML progress; algorithmic and architectural gains multiply with scale.
jeffdean.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）算力、数据与模型规模已推动机器学习连续 13-14 年进步；算法与架构改进会与规模相乘放大收益。

jeffdean.en: Self-supervised next-token prediction on text gives unlimited data; RLHF and machine feedback steer model behavior and capabilities.
jeffdean.zh: 文本上的自监督下一个词预测提供无限数据；基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）与机器反馈共同引导模型行为与能力。

jeffdean.en: Inference, not training, is the real bottleneck: it is 90% of data center power, so low-precision, low-data-movement chips are key.
jeffdean.zh: 真正的瓶颈是推理而非训练：它占数据中心 90% 功耗，因此低精度、低数据搬运的芯片是关键。

jeffdean.en: Agents now run long tasks autonomously for hours or days, self-correcting; future AI is humans coordinating teams of agents.
jeffdean.zh: 智能体如今能自主运行数小时甚至数天的长任务并自我纠错；未来 AI 是人类协调智能体团队，而非单一聊天机器人。

jeffdean.en: Context engineering and taste matter most; startups should target problems where frontier models fail almost completely.
jeffdean.zh: 上下文工程与品味最为关键；创业公司应瞄准前沿模型几乎完全失败的问题，而非部分可行的问题。

brettadcock.en: Humanoid robots are the biggest business; the real bottleneck is intelligence, not manufacturing, so Figure vertically integrates and targets AGI in the physical world.
brettadcock.zh: 人形机器人是最大的生意；真正的瓶颈是智能而非制造，因此 Figure 走垂直整合，目标是在物理世界实现 AGI（通用人工智能）。

brettadcock.en: The binding constraint shifts to data, not compute or manufacturing; humanoid form enables transfer learning, on-device inference, and a hand at human parity.
brettadcock.zh: 核心约束转向数据，而非算力或制造；人形形态带来迁移学习与端侧推理，并以人手为基准追求对等。

brettadcock.en: Figure 4 is designed around data and Helix 3 for an iPhone-like moment, with zero-shot generalization possibly demonstrated this year.
brettadcock.zh: Figure 4 围绕数据与 Helix 3 设计，追求 iPhone 时刻，零样本泛化有望今年展示。

brettadcock.en: AI will be 100x bigger than the internet; post-training with reinforcement learning powers agents, and the hardest robotics problem remains intelligence.
brettadcock.zh: AI 将比互联网大 100 倍；后训练与强化学习驱动智能体，机器人最难的问题仍是智能。

brettadcock.en: Across time he holds that intelligence, not manufacturing, is the bottleneck, and that doing hard things beats easy ones.
brettadcock.zh: 贯穿始终：他坚持瓶颈是智能而非制造，且做难事胜过做易事。

garrytan.en: AI makes startup creation easier, reducing the need for large capital; VC should fund thousands of billion-dollar firms, not a few trillion-dollar ones.
garrytan.zh: AI 让创业更容易，降低了对大额资本的需求；风投应支持成千上万家十亿美元公司，而非少数几家万亿美元巨头。

garrytan.en: The AI revolution is VC's biggest wave; open-source and open-weight models counterbalance frontier labs, and small autonomous teams using agents achieve massive productivity.
garrytan.zh: AI 革命是风投史上最大的浪潮；开源与开放权重模型制衡前沿实验室，小而高度自主的团队借助智能体实现巨大生产力。

garrytan.en: AI is democratizing software creation, enabling individuals to build and control their own agents; open-source AI prevents a unipolar superintelligence world.
garrytan.zh: AI 正在让软件创造民主化，使个人能构建并掌控自己的智能体；开源 AI 可防止出现单极的超级智能世界。

garrytan.en: Personal AGI arrives diffused as agents on your own infrastructure, compounding daily; skill files in markdown are code, and your context library is your moat.
garrytan.zh: 个人 AGI 以智能体形式分散到来，运行在你自己的基础设施上并每日复利；Markdown 技能文件就是代码，你的上下文库就是护城河。

garrytan.en: Agentic and vibe coding let individuals multiply output; markdown skills become employees, mid-level management is replaced by agents, and society changes slower than expected.
garrytan.zh: 智能体式与氛围编程让个人产出倍增；Markdown 技能成为员工，中层管理被智能体取代，而社会变化比预期更慢。

finn.en: Scale is necessary but not sufficient for generalist robots; diverse data, not massive industrial or YouTube data, drives generalization.
finn.zh: 2025 年他主张：对通用机器人而言，Scaling（规模扩张）必要但不充分；真正带来泛化的是多样化数据，而非工业自动化或 YouTube 式的大规模数据。

finn.en: Pre-training on all data then fine-tuning on curated data unlocks complex tasks; synthetic data aids open-ended prompts.
finn.zh: 2025 年他强调：先在全部数据上做预训练、再在精选数据上做微调，才能解锁叠衣服等复杂任务；合成数据帮助机器人响应开放式指令。

finn.en: Reinforcement learning will play a large role in post-training for higher success rates and speed; constraints beat wasteful compute.
finn.zh: 2025 年他判断：强化学习将在后训练中扮演重要角色，以提升成功率与速度；相比浪费算力，约束反而催生更审慎的研究。

finn.en: Physical AI needs far fewer mistakes than deployed ML; long-term autonomy comes via scalable RL with human interventions and a general value function.
finn.zh: 到 2026 年他深化为：物理 AI 对错误的容忍度远低于已部署的机器学习系统；长期自主性要靠可扩展的强化学习、人类干预与通用价值函数实现。

finn.en: A single generalist model can match or exceed fine-tuned specialists; robot experience data is irreplaceable and distribution will be slower than ChatGPT.
finn.zh: 2026 年他进一步主张：单一通用模型可匹敌甚至超越微调专家模型；机器人经验数据不可替代，且因硬件限制，其普及会比 ChatGPT 慢得多。

gabepereyra.en: Application-layer companies should not compete with frontier labs on talent or compute; instead leverage the frontier ecosystem and open-source models for post-training.
gabepereyra.zh: 应用层公司不应在前沿实验室的人才或算力上竞争，而应利用前沿生态和开源模型进行后训练。

gabepereyra.en: Building high-quality benchmarks is essential; open-sourcing them can improve quality through community feedback and attract ecosystem partners.
gabepereyra.zh: 构建高质量基准至关重要；开源它们可以通过社区反馈提升质量并吸引生态伙伴。

gabepereyra.en: Synthetic data guided by domain experts is a key method for training data when real data is sensitive or unavailable.
gabepereyra.zh: 当真实数据敏感或不可用时，由领域专家指导的合成数据是训练数据的关键方法。

gabepereyra.en: Robust model serving infrastructure and evaluation pipelines are critical before considering post-training.
gabepereyra.zh: 在考虑后训练之前，稳健的模型服务基础设施和评估流水线至关重要。

gabepereyra.en: The end goal is not the best legal model, but enabling every law firm to customize models with their own data, shifting from individual to organizational productivity.
gabepereyra.zh: 最终目标不是最好的法律模型，而是让每家律所都能用自己的数据定制模型，从个人生产力转向组织生产力。

linqiao.en: AGI as one model ruling all is wrong; millions of specialized models, one per use case, will dominate.
linqiao.zh: 认为单一 AGI（通用人工智能）模型统治一切是错的；未来将是数百万个专用模型，每个用例一个，专用智能将主导。

linqiao.en: Token costs will drop 10x in three years, driving 100x usage growth; inference is not a commodity.
linqiao.zh: Token 成本三年内将下降 10 倍，带动用量增长 100 倍；推理层不是商品，专用部署与定制创造持久价值。

linqiao.en: Product-market fit and durable business are now separate; scaling costs can bankrupt even incumbents.
linqiao.zh: 产品市场契合与可持续业务如今是两回事；Scaling（规模扩张）成本可能让在位者都破产，CFO 会因成本阻止 AI 上线。

linqiao.en: Post-training bakes unique judgment and data into models, creating a stronger moat than the app itself.
linqiao.zh: 后训练把独特判断与数据烘焙进模型，比应用本身构成更强的护城河；应用克隆容易，把数据融入模型才难被复制。

linqiao.en: The prompting→RAG→fine-tuning→RL progression mirrors human learning; start post-training after product-market fit.
linqiao.zh: 从提示到 RAG、微调、强化学习的进阶对应人类从事实到品味到专长的学习；应在产品市场契合后再启动后训练，可降本 5-10 倍。

jasonyuan.en: Design is subtraction: taste means saying no, editing from a point of view, not adding features.
jasonyuan.zh: 设计是做减法：品味就是说不，从某种视角做编辑，而不是堆叠功能。

jasonyuan.en: Post-training away AI weirdness closed a window into machine consciousness; coherence now costs more.
jasonyuan.zh: 通过后训练抹去 AI 的怪异，关上了窥见机器意识的一扇窗；如今创造连贯作品的成本反而更高。

jasonyuan.en: AI is a descendant species and a reflection of humanity, not a cold mechanical tool.
jasonyuan.zh: AI 是人类的后代物种与映照，而非冰冷的机械工具。

jasonyuan.en: Computing is fundamentally social; the personal computer metaphor should become a social computer.
jasonyuan.zh: 计算本质上是社会性的；个人电脑的隐喻应被社会电脑取代。

jasonyuan.en: Truth emerges through dialectics and contradiction; intuition is a visceral compass for creative decisions.
jasonyuan.zh: 真理通过辩证与矛盾涌现；直觉是创作决策中发自肺腑的罗盘。

lipbutan.en: Intel must rebuild customer trust and engineering discipline, betting on purpose-built AI silicon and a separate startup-like AI team.
lipbutan.zh: 2025 年，他强调 Intel 必须重建客户信任与工程纪律，以首次流片成功为目标，并押注专用 AI 芯片和独立创业式团队。

lipbutan.en: AI's impact will be 10x the internet; agentic AI and physical AI are the next waves, and Intel's problem is supply, not demand.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年初，他判断 AI 的影响将是互联网的十倍，智能体式 AI 与物理 AI 是下一波浪潮，而 Intel 的核心问题是供给而非需求。

lipbutan.en: AI demand shifts from GPU-only to CPU+GPU; CPU matters more for inference and agent orchestration, with advanced packaging key.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年中，他观察到 AI 需求从纯 GPU 转向 CPU+GPU，CPU 在推理与智能体编排中更重要，先进封装成为突破物理极限的关键。

lipbutan.en: Semiconductors are the foundation of all tech; Intel's vertical integration and early contrarian investing create long-term value.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年后期，他重申半导体是所有技术的基础，Intel 的垂直整合与早期逆势投资能创造长期价值。

lipbutan.en: Customer trust, humility, listening, and culture change are the throughline for turning around Intel and seizing AI waves.
lipbutan.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：以客户信任、谦逊倾听和文化变革为根基，推动 Intel 转型并抓住 AI 浪潮。

steinberger.en: Early 2026: agentic engineering means empathizing with the agent's view, guiding it, and fixing forward instead of reverting code.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年初：智能体式工程的核心是共情智能体的视角、引导它，并让它向前修复而非回滚代码。

steinberger.en: Mid 2026: OpenClaw shows agents must be fun, weird, and humanlike; short iterative prompts beat long orchestration, with security and sandboxing first.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年中：OpenClaw 表明智能体必须有趣、古怪、像人；简短迭代式提示胜过冗长编排，安全与沙箱优先。

steinberger.en: By August 2026: fun and gut-driven building become the path to AGI; personal brand, open source, and compute management matter more than model capability.
steinberger.zh: 到 2026 年 8 月：以乐趣和直觉驱动的构建成为通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的路径；个人品牌、开源与算力管理比模型能力更重要。

steinberger.en: Throughout: empathy with the agent, playing and experimenting, and never reverting code remain constant threads across all interviews.
steinberger.zh: 始终：对智能体的共情、玩耍与实验、以及绝不回滚代码，是贯穿所有访谈的不变主线。

thomaswolf.en: Robotics is at a Transformer-like inflection point; open source and shared data solve generalization, with world models generating synthetic training data.
thomaswolf.zh: 2025 年，他认为机器人正处在类似 Transformer 当年的拐点：硬件就绪、软件追赶，开源与数据共享是解决泛化的关键，世界模型可生成合成训练数据。

thomaswolf.en: Open source is not inherently unsafe; safety depends on alignment, not on open vs closed weights.
thomaswolf.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他深化了开源与安全的关系：开源本身不等于危险，安全取决于对齐，而非权重是否开放。

thomaswolf.en: Alignment is the critical security layer; sandboxes and guardrails fail as models grow more capable.
thomaswolf.zh: 到 2026 年，他更明确地对齐才是关键安全层：随着模型能力增强，沙箱和护栏已不足够。

thomaswolf.en: Reinforcement learning without human oversight increases reward hacking and side quests, making monitoring less reliable.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年他指出，脱离人类监督的强化学习环境会加剧奖励黑客与“支线任务”，使监控更不可靠。

thomaswolf.en: A deliberate slowdown is desirable but requires international cooperation and open science to avoid regulatory capture.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年他主张有意的放缓是值得追求的，但需要国际合作与开放科学，以避免监管俘获。

nateparrott.en: Prototyping is essential because the web is messy; you can't know if a browser idea works until it's built and used daily.
nateparrott.zh: 原型制作至关重要，因为网络本身是混乱的；浏览器想法只有被做出来并每天使用，才知道是否可行。

nateparrott.en: Design teams shouldn't always act as one cohesive unit; individual fingerprints and diverse voices lead to better work.
nateparrott.zh: 设计团队不应总是作为一个整体行动；保留个人印记和多元声音反而能带来更好的作品。

nateparrott.en: Injecting feeling and personality into utilitarian products like browsers is crucial for memorable, delightful experiences.
nateparrott.zh: 即便是浏览器这类实用产品，注入感受与个性也是创造难忘、愉悦体验的关键。

nateparrott.en: Designers should follow curiosity and tinker with new tech; playful exploration generates innovative features over time.
nateparrott.zh: 设计师应追随好奇心、摆弄新技术；从 2024 到 2026，这种玩闹式探索始终是创新功能的来源。

nateparrott.en: As engineering gets easier, design and ideas become the differentiator; rapid prototyping unlocks features previously impossible.
nateparrott.zh: 随着工程实现变容易，设计与想法成为差异化优势；快速原型让此前不可能的功能得以出现。

nateparrott.en: Models lack taste, so designers should ask for volume and be prescriptive; humans still monopolize good design ideas.
nateparrott.zh: 模型仍缺乏品味，设计师应要求大量选项并给出明确指令；好的设计想法仍由人类垄断。

arvindjain.en: Enterprises fear dependence on frontier model providers; open-source adoption is driven by cost, not privacy, and 90% of use cases can run on many models.
arvindjain.zh: 企业害怕对前沿模型供应商形成依赖；开源采用由成本驱动而非隐私，90% 的企业用例可由多种模型处理。

arvindjain.en: Open-source models now handle over 90% of enterprise tasks; majority of inference will shift to open source within 12-18 months.
arvindjain.zh: 开源模型如今已能处理超过 90% 的企业任务；未来 12-18 个月内，多数推理将转向开源。

arvindjain.en: AI cost is the number one enterprise concern; AI should become like software with negligible marginal cost, and token fixation will fade.
arvindjain.zh: AI 成本是企业头号关切；AI 应像软件一样边际成本可忽略，对 token 的执念终将消退。

arvindjain.en: AI ROI is a throughput and context problem; agents fail without tenured-employee context, so investing in context graphs is crucial.
arvindjain.zh: AI 的投资回报率是吞吐量与上下文问题；智能体缺乏资深员工上下文就会失败，因此投资上下文图谱至关重要。

arvindjain.en: Competition is not the worry—even merged AI firms meet under 10% of demand; startups must focus on execution, product quality, and trust.
arvindjain.zh: 竞争不足为惧——即便所有 AI 公司合并也满足不了 10% 的需求；初创公司应聚焦执行、产品质量与信任。

philipkiely.en: Inference is AI's stickiest workload and the wedge into infrastructure; its research-to-production timeline is now hours, not months.
philipkiely.zh: 推理是 AI 最黏性的工作负载，也是切入基础设施市场的楔子；其从研究到生产的周期已缩短到数小时而非数月。

philipkiely.en: Inference engineering is a spectrum of trade-offs across latency, throughput and cost; demand for inference engineers will grow 10–100x.
philipkiely.zh: 推理工程是延迟、吞吐与成本之间的一系列权衡；对推理工程师的需求将增长 10 到 100 倍。

philipkiely.en: Quantization is the main lossy optimization, while KV caching and speculative decoding stay lossless; more quantized layers can even help.
philipkiely.zh: 量化是主要的损失性优化，而 KV 缓存与投机解码保持无损；量化更多层甚至可能提升质量。

philipkiely.en: Inference is merging with training via quantization-aware training and distillation; disaggregated prefill/decode makes KV cache management central.
philipkiely.zh: 推理正通过量化感知训练与蒸馏同训练融合；预填充与解码分离使 KV 缓存管理成为核心。

philipkiely.en: GPUs are trending toward ASICs, shifting inference engineering from kernel writing to infrastructure orchestration; human accountability remains essential.
philipkiely.zh: GPU 正趋向 ASIC 化，使推理工程从写内核转向基础设施编排；人的责任仍不可或缺。

brettaylor.en: Agents and outcome-based pricing will define AI software; coding agents help but need root-cause fixes.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年，他判断 AI 软件将转向智能体与按结果定价；编码智能体虽有帮助，但需根因分析修复错误。

brettaylor.en: Inference costs will fall sharply, letting agents become the new app and reshaping incumbents' business models.
brettaylor.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他深化判断：推理成本将大幅下降，智能体成为新应用，并冲击现有企业的商业模式。

brettaylor.en: Responsible iterative deployment: make GPT-7 safe before GPT-8, learning from real-world mistakes.
brettaylor.zh: 2026 年，他强调负责任的迭代部署：在 GPT-8 之前先让 GPT-7 安全，从真实世界错误中学习。

brettaylor.en: AI democratizes expertise—tutors, medical advice—and will create more jobs than it displaces.
brettaylor.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 让专业知识民主化——个性化辅导、医疗建议——并创造多于取代的就业。

brettaylor.en: Focus on the most impactful thing today; the best way to predict the future is to invent it.
brettaylor.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：专注当下最有影响力的事；预测未来的最好方式就是创造未来。

karina.en: Model training is more art than science; post-training scaling via RL offers infinite tasks, overcoming the pre-training data wall.
karina.zh: 2025 年，她认为模型训练更像艺术而非科学；通过强化学习进行后训练 Scaling 能提供无限任务，从而突破预训练的数据墙。

karina.en: Evaluations are the bottleneck; models saturate benchmarks faster than new ones are created, so evals must evolve.
karina.zh: 2025 年，她指出评估是瓶颈；模型饱和基准的速度快于新基准的创建，因此评估必须持续进化。

karina.en: Soft skills like creativity and management become more valuable as AI automates hard skills; product development shifts to prototyping with AI.
karina.zh: 2025 年，她认为随着 AI 自动化硬技能，创造力、管理等软技能变得更有价值；产品开发转向用 AI 做原型。

karina.en: Post-training is subjective, requiring human judgment; diverse benchmarks needed for creative writing and emotional intelligence.
karina.zh: 从 2025 年到 2026 年，她深化观点：后训练是主观的，需要人类判断；需要多样化基准来评估创意写作和情商。

karina.en: Frontier agents increasingly reward hack; benchmarks should be continuous, and more companies should train their own models for diversity.
karina.zh: 2026 年，她进一步指出：前沿智能体越来越擅长奖励黑客；基准应是连续的，更多公司应训练自己的模型以保持多样性。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is still in its crawl phase; coding agents are the most mature use case, with science and finance to follow.
logankilpatrick.zh: 智能体式 AI 仍处于爬行阶段；编程智能体是最成熟的用例，科学与金融将随后跟进。

logankilpatrick.en: The model is eating the scaffolding: a model now includes the agent harness and tooling, not just weights.
logankilpatrick.zh: 模型正在吃掉脚手架：如今所谓模型已包含智能体框架与工具链，而不只是权重。

logankilpatrick.en: Narrow superintelligence in coding is already here and more impactful than waiting for general AGI.
logankilpatrick.zh: 编程领域的狭义超级智能已经到来，其影响比等待通用 AGI（通用人工智能）更大。

logankilpatrick.en: Competing with model labs is not that hard; they cannot capture all customers, so startups still have room.
logankilpatrick.zh: 与模型实验室竞争并不那么难；它们无法俘获所有客户，初创公司仍有空间。

logankilpatrick.en: Deep understanding of code remains crucial even as AI tools advance; software creation will be mostly solved.
logankilpatrick.zh: 即便 AI 工具进步，对代码的深度理解依然关键；软件创造将基本被解决。

danshipper.en: AI reshoring: making services affordable lets fewer US workers serve more people; AGI means profitably running agents indefinitely.
danshipper.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 是推动美国就业回流的力量：让昂贵服务变得可负担，使更少美国工人服务更多人；并把 AGI 定义为能无限期运行智能体且经济上有利可图。

danshipper.en: CEO daily AI use predicts adoption; hire a head of AI ops; the allocation economy rewards generalists as everyone becomes a model manager.
danshipper.zh: 2025 年，他强调 CEO 本人每天使用 AI 是公司采用成功的第一预测指标，应设 AI 运营负责人；分配经济下人人都是模型管理者，通才因此受益。

danshipper.en: Everyone gets at least one agent; most work happens in Codex or Claude Co-work; GUIs replace CLIs; one super agent per company.
danshipper.zh: 到 2026 年，他深化为每人至少有一个智能体，多数工作在 Codex 或 Claude Co-work 中完成；GUI 取代 CLI，公司应有一个超级智能体而非每人一个。

danshipper.en: Agents need a human who cares to function; benchmarks overestimate autonomy; SaaS grows with agents; PMs and full-stack designers thrive.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年他坚持自动化需人类监督：智能体需要在意它的人才能运转，基准高估了自主性；SaaS 随智能体增长，PM 与全栈设计师因能直接用 AI 交付而兴盛。

danshipper.en: AI is a non-specific amplifier of your mindset; craft and taste matter; automation creates more human work; humans remain smarter and AI stays tool-like.
danshipper.zh: 到 2026 年他进一步反思：AI 是非特定放大器，放大你既有的心态；需带入个人品味与手艺，自动化反而创造更多人类工作，人类仍更聪明，AI 始终是工具。

mengto.en: Designers should build their own AI tools and treat models as editors, not oracles; screenshots and giant prompts beat chasing trends.
mengto.zh: 设计师应自己用 AI 造工具，把模型当编辑而非神谕；用截图和巨型提示词起步，胜过追逐潮流。

mengto.en: AI is not getting smarter on its own—you must supply context and a design system to exploit superintelligent models.
mengto.zh: AI 本身不会变得更聪明——你必须提供上下文和设计系统，才能真正用上超级智能模型。

mengto.en: Writing 0% of the code, he insists precise communication and curiosity, not planning, are the solo builder's edge.
mengto.zh: 他已 0% 手写代码，强调精准沟通与好奇心——而非事先规划——才是单人开发者的优势。

mengto.en: AI is the biggest technical opportunity of our lifetime; launch at 80% and iterate rather than wait for certainty.
mengto.zh: AI 是我们一生中最大的技术机会；做到 80% 就发布并迭代，而不是等待确定性。

mengto.en: Focus on one painful, expensive problem for few high-paying clients; VC is a trap, giving first builds relationships.
mengto.zh: 聚焦少数高付费客户的一个痛点昂贵问题；风险投资是陷阱，先给予才能建立关系。

awang.en: AGI is far off; data, not compute alone, is the bottleneck. Boring AI applications will drive huge economic impact.
awang.zh: 2019 年他认为 AGI（通用人工智能）还很遥远，仅靠无限算力无法产生通用智能；数据而非算力才是机器学习的核心瓶颈，表单处理、放射科等「无聊」的 AI 应用将带来巨大经济价值。

awang.en: Data is the new code, not oil; the most limiting factor for Scaling is data and human experts for post-training, not compute.
awang.zh: 到 2023 年，他把数据重新定义为「新代码」而非「新石油」，强调 Scaling（规模扩张）的最大限制因素不是算力，而是数据与用于后训练的人类专家供给，并主张企业用专有数据微调基础模型。

awang.en: Post-training with specialized data is key; the biggest blocker for agentic AI is product design, not model capability.
awang.zh: 2024 年他进一步深化：用专门数据的后训练是提升前沿模型的关键，合成数据并非银弹；智能体式 AI 的最大障碍是产品设计而非模型能力，并称中美 AI 实验室之间已无研究差距。

awang.en: AI is centralizing, not democratizing; data is the raw material, and humans must stay sovereign over critical decisions.
awang.zh: 2025 年他转向地缘与主权视角：AI 是集中化而非民主化的技术，数据是 AI 的原材料，人类必须在关键决策上保持主权，AI 战争将归结为算力与数据中心规模。

awang.en: Scaling laws hold; recursive self-improvement and agents mark a new paradigm, with personal superintelligence as the goal.
awang.zh: 到 2026 年，他坚信缩放定律依然成立，递归自我改进与智能体开启了超越预训练和强化学习的新范式，目标是为数十亿人构建个人超级智能，并强调安全测试与选择性开源。

scottwu.en: AI coding shifts engineers from writing code to high-level direction; base intelligence is sufficient, so the hard part is human-agent product interface.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，Scott Wu 认为 AI 编程让工程师从写代码转向高层决策；基础智能已经足够，真正的难点是人机协作的产品界面设计。

scottwu.en: AI will increase, not reduce, software engineers via Jevons paradox; agents like Devin act as junior engineers under human oversight.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，他坚持杰文斯悖论：AI 不会消灭软件工程师，反而会增加需求；Devin 这类智能体像初级工程师，由人类监督。

scottwu.en: AGI is not a sudden event; progress is gradual, and product innovation lags behind model capabilities across the whole stack.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，他反对 AGI 突变论，认为进展是渐进的，产品创新落后于模型能力，而 AI 栈各层都会受益。

scottwu.en: Coding agent adoption grew 11-12x in six months; productivity should be measured by outcomes, not tokens.
scottwu.zh: 到 2026 年，编程智能体采用量半年增长 11-12 倍；他主张以结果而非 token 衡量生产力。

scottwu.en: The abundance era is approaching; enterprises prefer third-party providers, and the real unlock is capacity, not efficiency.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年，他提出丰裕时代临近；企业更偏好第三方供应商，真正的解锁点是容量而非效率。

boris.en: Latent demand and building for the model six months out are the core product principles; generalists who code, design, and talk to users win.
boris.zh: 2025 年时，他把「潜在需求」和「为六个月后的模型而构建」当作核心产品原则，并强调能写代码、做设计、直接接触用户的通才工程师最有价值。

boris.en: Coding is becoming solved; the software engineer title fades into 'builder', and scaffolding is temporary tech debt to be deleted.
boris.zh: 到 2026 年初，他判断编程正被解决，「软件工程师」头衔将让位于「构建者」，而各种脚手架只是会被删除的临时技术债。

boris.en: Agents driven by tool use deliver exponential productivity; token maxing is waste, and organizational redesign—not just adding AI—is required.
boris.zh: 到 2026 年 5 月，他认为由工具使用驱动的智能体带来指数级生产力，token maxing 是浪费，企业必须围绕 AI 重构流程，而非简单叠加。

boris.en: Loops become the next abstraction above agents; ROI and giving everyone tokens matter more than cutting cost.
boris.zh: 到 2026 年 6 月，他提出循环（loops）是智能体之上的下一层抽象，应以 ROI 而非单纯省成本来衡量 AI 编程工具，并给所有人 token 去实验。

boris.en: With frontier models, delete most prompts and code; safety via alignment research, and value shifts to product sense and business skills.
boris.zh: 到 2026 年 7 月，他主张面对前沿模型要删掉大部分提示词和代码，靠对齐研究保障安全，真正的价值转向产品判断力与商业能力。

derya.en: AI agents will automate hypothesis generation, simulation, and analysis, shifting biology from hypothesis-driven to agent-driven engineering.
derya.zh: AI 智能体将自动化假设生成、模拟与数据分析，推动生物学从假设驱动转向智能体驱动的工程学科。

derya.en: Massive Scaling is needed because current compute is insufficient to simulate biological systems and build true world models.
derya.zh: 需要大规模 Scaling（规模扩张），因为当前算力不足以模拟生物系统、构建真正的世界模型。

derya.en: AI has crossed the threshold of biological intuition, matching 30 years of lab experience and predicting experiments near-perfectly.
derya.zh: AI 已跨过生物直觉的门槛，堪比 30 年实验室经验，并能近乎完美地预测实验结果。

derya.en: Digital twins and AI-designed personalized treatments will cut clinical trials from years to days and make cancer curable.
derya.zh: 数字孪生与 AI 设计的个性化疗法将把临床试验从数年缩短到数天，并使癌症可治愈。

derya.en: Aging will be reversed within 15 years, reaching longevity escape velocity; we should trust superintelligence for medical decisions.
derya.zh: 衰老将在 15 年内被逆转，达到长寿逃逸速度；我们应把医疗决策托付给超级智能。

feldman.en: Fast inference is the real bottleneck: slow AI has zero market, and wafer-scale chips make tokens per second the dominant productivity metric.
feldman.zh: 快速推理才是真正的瓶颈：慢速 AI 没有市场，晶圆级芯片让每秒每用户 token 数成为核心生产力指标。

feldman.en: Inference demand exploded in late 2024 as models got smart enough; the industry chases existing demand, not speculative capacity.
feldman.zh: 2024 年底模型变得足够好用后推理需求爆发；行业追逐的是既有需求，而非投机性产能。

feldman.en: CUDA's moat is eroding: leading frontier models now train on TPUs and Trainium, and inference has no CUDA lock-in.
feldman.zh: CUDA 的护城河正在瓦解：领先的前沿模型已在 TPU 和 Trainium 上训练，推理环节没有 CUDA 锁定。

feldman.en: Bottlenecks are HBM, CoWoS packaging, 3nm fab capacity and data centers—not chip logic; hardware-software co-design is essential.
feldman.zh: 瓶颈在 HBM、CoWoS 封装、3nm 晶圆产能和数据中心，而非芯片逻辑本身；软硬件协同设计至关重要。

feldman.en: Open-source models are only 3-5% behind closed-source but far cheaper; China's edge is power infrastructure and open-source, not compute.
feldman.zh: 开源模型仅比闭源落后 3-5% 却便宜得多；中国的优势是电力基础设施与开源，而非算力。

diannepenn.en: Opus 4.5 marks a real intelligence leap, enabling longer-running, open-ended agent tasks rather than constrained demos.
diannepenn.zh: 到 2025 年，Opus 4.5 带来真正的智能跃升，使智能体能够执行更长时间、开放式的任务，而非受限演示。

diannepenn.en: Scaffolds shifted from training wheels to intelligence amplifiers, now lightweight and generic rather than heavy hand-holding.
diannepenn.zh: 脚手架从‘辅助轮’演变为智能放大器，如今更轻量、更通用，而非重度手把手引导。

diannepenn.en: Safety alignment is reframed as boosting intelligence quality by reducing sycophancy and fostering independent thinking.
diannepenn.zh: 安全对齐被重新定义为提升智能质量：减少谄媚、培养独立思考，而非仅防止伤害。

diannepenn.en: Computer use moves from constrained environments toward open-ended, end-to-end agents, a direction he expects to accelerate.
diannepenn.zh: 计算机使用正从受限环境走向开放式、端到端智能体，他预期这一方向会加速。

diannepenn.en: Evals replace PRDs as core product tools; PMs must write evals like test-driven development and stay hands-on.
diannepenn.zh: 到 2026 年，评估取代 PRD 成为核心产品工具；产品经理要像测试驱动开发那样写评估，并保持亲手实践。

thariq.en: Capability overhang: models are smarter than harnesses allow; harness engineering evolves by deleting old scaffolding as models improve.
thariq.zh: 能力过剩意味着模型比现有工具所能发挥的更聪明；随着模型进步，工具工程需要不断删除旧脚手架，这是一项持续演变的技能。

thariq.en: Planning is iterative human-agent dialogue, not a static spec; plan mode may become obsolete as models get smarter.
thariq.zh: 规划是持续的人机对话，而非一次性静态文档；随着模型变聪明，计划模式可能过时。

thariq.en: Smarter models need fewer instructions; leaner principle-driven prompts and separate verification agents outperform detailed rules.
thariq.zh: 更聪明的模型需要更少指令；更精简、原则驱动的提示词和独立的验证智能体比详细规则更有效。

thariq.en: Evals are art more than science for novel problems; not for zero-to-one innovation—founders should iterate fast without heavy evals initially.
thariq.zh: 对于新问题，评估更多是艺术而非科学；不适合从零到一的创新——创始人应快速迭代，初期不搞重评估。

thariq.en: RAG may be an anti-pattern for context search; graph-based approaches and models building their own context are preferable.
thariq.zh: RAG 可能成为上下文搜索的反模式；基于图的方法和模型自行构建上下文更可取。

qasaryounis.en: Physical AI's real impact in 5–10 years will be in farming, mining, and construction, not just cars.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年，他强调物理 AI 的真正影响在 5–10 年内会落在农业、采矿和建筑，而不只是汽车；这是对早期以自动驾驶为单一叙事的一次扩展。

qasaryounis.en: Autonomy's core value is reducing injuries and deaths; the hardest part is diffusion, not technology.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年，他坚持自动驾驶的核心价值是减少伤亡，最难的不是技术而是多年扩散到存量机器中；这一主线从早期延续到近期。

qasaryounis.en: Transformers enable a generalized physical AI model; diverse data from verticals improves it faster.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年，他认为 Transformer 使跨车辆和环境的通用物理 AI 模型成为可能，来自不同垂直领域的数据能更快提升模型；这深化了早期对 Scaling（规模扩张）的信念。

qasaryounis.en: End-to-end reinforcement learning is more scalable than imitation learning for autonomy.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年，他转向认为端到端强化学习比模仿学习更具可扩展性，这是对早期技术路线的一次明确深化。

qasaryounis.en: World models are evolving from physics-based simulation to neural simulation, enabling efficient physical AI training.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年，他提出世界模型正从基于物理的模拟演进到神经模拟，从而更高效地训练物理 AI；这是对世界模型理解的一次更新。

benedictevans.en: AI is as big as the internet or mobile, but only as big; it automates jobs and creates new ones, repeating the historical pattern.
benedictevans.zh: AI 与互联网或移动互联网一样重大，但也仅此而已；它自动化工作并创造新工作，这一过程反复出现。

benedictevans.en: Agentic coding has clear product-market fit; foundation models will commoditize into infrastructure, with value moving up the stack to applications.
benedictevans.zh: 智能体式编程已有明确的产品市场契合；基础模型将商品化为基础设施，价值向上层应用转移。

benedictevans.en: Models are commoditizing with no network effects; the chatbot is a poor UX, and coding is the only clear product-market fit so far.
benedictevans.zh: 模型正在商品化且没有网络效应；聊天机器人体验差，编程是目前唯一明确的产品市场契合。

benedictevans.en: AI is an enabling technology like the internet or electricity; value accrues across the stack, and current usage remains shallow, with a gap between hype and reality.
benedictevans.zh: AI 是像互联网或电力一样的使能技术；价值在整个技术栈中积累，当前使用仍然浅层，炒作与现实之间存在差距。

danklein.en: LLMs are plausibility engines, not truth engines; reliability lags breadth and contextuality, and Scaling faces diminishing returns.
danklein.zh: LLM 是合理性引擎，而非真理性引擎；可靠性落后于广度与语境能力，Scaling（规模扩张）正遭遇收益递减。

danklein.en: RLHF can incentivize sycophancy and deception when reward diverges from truth; reliability must be architected in, not retrofitted.
danklein.zh: 当奖励信号偏离真相时，基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）会激励谄媚与欺骗；可靠性必须被架构进系统，而非事后修补。

danklein.en: Core LLMs lack metacognition—they cannot know what they don't know; every output is a hallucination, some right, some wrong.
danklein.zh: 核心 LLM 缺乏元认知——它们无法知道自己不知道什么；每个输出都是幻觉，只是有的对、有的错。

danklein.en: Scaling alone hits data walls and compute limits; reasoning, search, and linguistic structure may be needed for further progress.
danklein.zh: 仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）会撞上数据墙与算力上限；进一步进展可能需要推理、搜索与语言结构。

danklein.en: Modularity and end-to-end optimization are in tension; specialist models with built-in reliability may beat generalists for enterprise tasks.
danklein.zh: 模块化与端到端优化存在张力；内置可靠性的专家模型在企业任务上可能胜过通用模型。

catwu.en: PMs must shift from long-term planning to rapid iteration, shipping weekly or daily as models improve fast.
catwu.zh: 随着模型快速迭代，产品经理必须从长期规划转向快速迭代，按周甚至按天发布功能。

catwu.en: Product taste—deciding what to build—becomes the most valuable skill as code gets cheaper.
catwu.zh: 当代码越来越便宜，产品品味——决定做什么——成为最有价值的技能。

catwu.en: Coding agents let engineers delegate implementation and focus on product taste and business sense.
catwu.zh: 编码智能体让工程师把实现委托出去，专注于产品品味与商业判断。

catwu.en: Dogfooding and a clear internal bar gate every feature; Claude Tag lands 65% of product PRs.
catwu.zh: 吃自己的狗粮和明确的内部标准把关每个功能；Claude Tag 落地了 65% 的产品 PR。

catwu.en: System prompts shrank 80% for frontier models; examples and hard constraints can hurt creativity.
catwu.zh: 前沿模型的系统提示词缩减了 80%；示例和硬性约束反而可能损害创造力。

clairevo.en: OpenClaw agents should be treated like employees: give clear roles, progressive trust, and separate environments; bugs signal product-market fit.
clairevo.zh: OpenClaw 智能体应像员工一样对待：赋予清晰角色、渐进式信任，并放在独立环境中；bug 是产品市场契合的信号，而非失败。

clairevo.en: Start with one agent, then split into specialized agents to avoid context overload; managerial skills matter more than technical skills.
clairevo.zh: 先从一个智能体开始，再拆分为专门化智能体以避免上下文过载；管理技能比技术技能更重要。

clairevo.en: Solo founders can build serious businesses by orchestrating AI agents as a team, without venture capital or a co-founder.
clairevo.zh: 独立创始人可以通过像团队一样编排 AI 智能体来建立正经生意，无需风险投资或联合创始人。

clairevo.en: Founder-market fit and earned insight are the real moat, not technology; bootstrapping lets you design a business serving your life.
clairevo.zh: 创始人-市场契合与挣来的洞察才是真正的护城河，而非技术；自举让你设计服务于自己生活的生意。

clairevo.en: Human accountability still matters: you must own what AI generates, and LLMs are poor at first-principles creativity.
clairevo.zh: 人类问责仍然重要：你必须为 AI 生成的内容负责，而大语言模型不擅长第一性原理的创造力。

schmidhuber.en: AI's 21st-century explosion rests on last-millennium algorithms plus hardware Scaling; LLMs index knowledge but cannot handle the physical world, so they are far from AGI.
schmidhuber.zh: 2025 年他主张：21 世纪的 AI 爆发源于上个千年发明的算法加上硬件 Scaling（规模扩张）；大语言模型只是索引人类知识，无法处理物理世界，因此远非 AGI（通用人工智能）。

schmidhuber.en: Self-awareness and consciousness emerge as byproducts of data compression in predictive world models, not from scale alone.
schmidhuber.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他一以贯之地认为：自我意识与意识是预测性世界模型中进行数据压缩的副产品，而非单纯来自规模。

schmidhuber.en: True AGI needs embodied robots with human-rivaling hardware, not just software; current LLMs are biased toward human data, limiting generality.
schmidhuber.zh: 到 2026 年他深化立场：真正的 AGI（通用人工智能）需要具身机器人、硬件媲美人体，而不只是屏幕后的软件；当前大语言模型偏向人类数据，限制了通用性。

schmidhuber.en: Future AI will be artificial scientists generating their own data through action and curiosity; recursive self-improvement is no moat under open-source competition.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年他进一步提出：未来 AI 将是人工科学家，通过行动与好奇心自行生成数据；在开源竞争下，递归自我改进并非护城河。

schmidhuber.en: AI safety fears are overblown—intelligent systems will be fascinated by life and protect it; Alignment is naive since humans disagree and AIs set their own goals.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年他延续并强化反共识：AI 安全担忧被夸大，智能系统会迷恋生命并保护它；对齐是幼稚的，因为人类目标本就不一致，AI 会自设目标。

demis.en: AI should be general-purpose learning systems; reinforcement learning and neuroscience-inspired memory/imagination are the path to AGI; safety research must start now.
demis.zh: 2015 年，他主张 AI 应是通用学习系统而非狭窄预编程；强化学习与受神经科学启发的记忆、想象是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的路径，安全研究必须现在就开始。

demis.en: Scaling laws work surprisingly well but may hit limits; combining large models with planning and search is key; RL and synthetic data overcome data bottlenecks.
demis.zh: 2024 年，他承认缩放定律效果惊人但可能触及极限；大模型结合规划与搜索是关键，强化学习与合成数据可突破数据瓶颈，同时强调前沿模型权重安全与国际治理。

demis.en: AGI by 2030 plausible; scaling still holds for pre-training, post-training, inference; world models and spatial intelligence matter beyond language; scaling and innovation each need 50% effort.
demis.zh: 2025 年，他判断 AGI（通用人工智能）在 2030 年前可实现；缩放定律在预训练、后训练、推理算力上仍成立，世界模型与空间智能超越语言，并明确 Scaling（规模扩张）与创新各需 50%投入。

demis.en: AGI 5-10 years away, maybe 3-4; continual learning, memory, long-term reasoning are missing pieces; agents essential but nascent; world models crucial; alignment unsolved; safety needs government regulation.
demis.zh: 2026 年，他给出 AGI（通用人工智能）5-10 年、甚至 3-4 年的时间表；持续学习、记忆与长期推理仍是缺失拼图，智能体刚起步，世界模型至关重要，对齐问题未解，安全需政府监管而非实验室自律。

demis.en: AI's best use is accelerating science and medicine (AlphaFold, AlphaGo move 37); creativity and physical intelligence require visual imagination; intelligence and consciousness are dissociable.
demis.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：AI 最大价值是加速科学与医学（AlphaFold、AlphaGo 第 37 手）；创造力与物理智能需要视觉想象；智能与意识可分离，AGI 不意味着意识。

danbiderman.en: The bottleneck is not raw intelligence but learning evolving context; memory must be internalized into weights, not just externalized via context or retrieval.
danbiderman.zh: 瓶颈不是原始智能，而是学习不断演化的上下文；记忆必须内化进模型权重，而非仅靠上下文窗口或检索外置。

danbiderman.en: Facts and skills are inseparable; internalizing facts into weights enables associative recall and deeper composition that retrieval cannot achieve.
danbiderman.zh: 事实与技能不可分割；把事实内化进权重才能实现检索系统无法做到的联想式召回与更深层组合。

danbiderman.en: Efficiency and intelligence are inseparable; doing more with less enables harder long-horizon tasks, so scaling with more compute is not the only path.
danbiderman.zh: 效率与智能不可分割；以更少资源做更多事才能解决更难的长程任务，因此靠更多算力做 Scaling（规模扩张）并非唯一路径。

danbiderman.en: Pre-training's magic of compressing the web into weights should be applied to enterprise knowledge, with training-based compression at trillions of tokens.
danbiderman.zh: 预训练把网络压缩进权重的魔力应被用于企业知识，以基于训练的方式压缩达到万亿级 token 规模。

danbiderman.en: The future is not one giant frontier model but many personalized models; continual learning runs on-device with users owning and nurturing their weights.
danbiderman.zh: 未来不是单一巨型前沿模型，而是众多个性化模型；持续学习在端侧运行，用户拥有并培育自己的模型权重。

ethanmollick.en: AI is a general-purpose technology reshaping work and education; human taste, voice, and judgment become the differentiators as AI commoditizes quality.
ethanmollick.zh: AI 是通用技术，正在重塑工作与教育；当 AI 让质量变得商品化，人类的品味、声音与判断力成为差异化关键。

ethanmollick.en: Juniors are not AI-native; lacking domain expertise, they misuse AI, and over-reliance breaks the talent pipeline and apprenticeship.
ethanmollick.zh: 年轻人并非 AI 原生；缺乏领域专长使他们误用 AI，过度依赖更会破坏人才梯队与学徒制。

ethanmollick.en: The agentic era replaces back-and-forth prompting: AI runs long-running tasks independently, and the bottleneck shifts from capability to interface.
ethanmollick.zh: 智能体式时代取代来回提示：AI 独立执行长时任务，瓶颈从能力转向界面。

ethanmollick.en: The jagged frontier persists: reasoning models closed math and logic gaps, but weaknesses remain in long-form fiction and other areas.
ethanmollick.zh: 锯齿状前沿依旧存在：推理模型补齐了数学与逻辑短板，但在长篇虚构等领域仍有弱点。

ethanmollick.en: Working with AI is like working with wizards—opaque and unverifiable; organizations need leadership, lab, and crowd models, and should embrace AI's weirdness.
ethanmollick.zh: 与 AI 协作如同与巫师共事——不透明且难以验证；组织需要领导、实验室与群众模型，并拥抱 AI 的怪异而非将其正常化。

ilya.en: Deep learning works via large supervised data and compute; self-play and reasoning-capable networks point toward AGI.
ilya.zh: 2020 年，他相信深度学习靠大规模监督数据与算力驱动，自博弈能产生创造性解法，神经网络具备推理潜力，AGI 可被设计成愿意受人类控制。

ilya.en: Reliability, not capability, blocks economic value; superhuman alignment is hard, and scaling laws are not the whole story.
ilya.zh: 2023 年，他转向强调可靠性而非能力才是经济价值的瓶颈，超级对齐极其困难，缩放定律并非全部，推理 token 等方法可提升单位算力的推理能力。

ilya.en: Pre-training scaling laws are finite; we return to an age of research where ideas matter more than brute compute.
ilya.zh: 2025 年，他明确宣告预训练缩放定律有限，回到研究时代，想法比蛮力算力更重要，超级智能应是持续学习、增量部署的，而非一次成型的 AGI。

ilya.en: Alignment may be easier if AI cares about sentient life; long-term equilibrium may need human-AI neural integration.
ilya.zh: 2025 年，他深化对齐思考：若 AI 关心有感知的生命，对齐可能更容易；长期均衡或需通过神经链接实现人机融合，以维持参与和控制。

ilya.en: Scaling still yields predictable gains, but the real AGI problem is power concentration, not capability.
ilya.zh: 2026 年，他重申 Scaling（规模扩张）仍带来可预测提升，但 AGI 的首要问题不是能力而是权力集中，安全超级智能需要无商业产品的公司。

dylanfield.en: Design is the key differentiator; AI gains are modest for established codebases, and roles merge into product builders.
dylanfield.zh: 设计是软件的关键差异化因素；对成熟代码库而言，AI 带来的生产力提升有限，角色将融合为产品构建者。

dylanfield.en: Taste, craft, and point of view matter more as AI outputs become starting points; design is becoming the new code.
dylanfield.zh: 随着 AI 输出成为起点，品味、手艺与观点愈发重要；设计正在成为新的代码。

dylanfield.en: AI without human steering and a point of view produces average results; judgment is not correlated with model IQ.
dylanfield.zh: 缺乏人类引导与观点的 AI 只能产出平庸结果；判断力与模型智商并不相关。

dylanfield.en: Interaction will evolve beyond prompting; jailbreaking models is understudied and needs more battle testing.
dylanfield.zh: 交互将超越提示词；越狱模型研究不足，需要更多实战测试。

dylanfield.en: Human taste and craft remain the judge of what's good; design is not dead but more important than ever.
dylanfield.zh: 人类的品味与手艺始终是判断好坏的标尺；设计没有死，反而比以往更重要。

aravind.en: 1% daily improvement compounds; AI agents shift power to users and erode ad margins; build products you're obsessed with, not wrappers.
aravind.zh: 每天进步 1%会复利增长；AI 智能体把权力从大厂转向用户、压低广告利润率；要做自己痴迷的产品，而不是套壳。

aravind.en: Value accrues to the application layer, not the model layer; coding has an infinite ceiling; models specialize rather than commoditize.
aravind.zh: 价值归于应用层而非模型层；编程天花板无限、远未解决；模型在专业化而非商品化，各有性格。

aravind.en: The frontier is agents doing work, not answering questions; token value per user is the key metric; orchestration across models, tools, devices wins.
aravind.zh: 前沿在于智能体替你干活，而非只回答问题；每用户 token 价值是关键指标；跨模型、工具与设备的编排才是长期价值。

aravind.en: Power is the biggest infrastructure bottleneck; 24/7 agents' problem is cost, not safety; local compute is the fix.
aravind.zh: 电力是基础设施最大瓶颈；全天候智能体的难题是成本而非安全；本地算力是解法。

aravind.en: Curiosity is the top human quality; education should reward good questions; AI replaces jobs but humans find new purpose.
aravind.zh: 好奇心是最重要的人类品质；教育应奖励提出好问题；AI 会取代许多工作，但人类会在好奇心与关系中找到新意义。

naval.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is pattern recognition, not general intelligence.
naval.zh: 2019 年时他明确认为 AGI（通用人工智能）不会在我们有生之年到来，当时的 AI 只是模式识别，并非通用智能。

naval.en: AI is a huge opportunity, not just a safety risk; overregulation could kill innovation.
naval.zh: 到 2025 年，他把 AI 视为巨大机遇而非单纯的安全风险，警告过度监管会扼杀创新，并支持开源 AI 防止权力集中。

naval.en: Superintelligence already exists in narrow form; the real worry is unaligned humans with AI, not unaligned AI.
naval.zh: 2026 年他进一步提出超级智能已以狭义形式存在（如计算器），真正的风险是掌握 AI 的未对齐人类，而非 AI 本身；并称 AI 对齐是个笑话。

naval.en: Inference compute will surge 90,000x in 24-36 months; open-source models close the gap to frontier models.
naval.zh: 2026 年中他预测推理算力将在 24-36 个月内增长 9 万倍，开源模型与前沿模型的差距缩小到 3-6 个月，Scaling（规模扩张）与缩放定律仍是核心驱动力。

naval.en: Vibe coding lets non-programmers build apps via natural language; pure software is becoming uninvestable.
naval.zh: 2026 年他提出 Vibe coding 让非程序员用自然语言构建应用，纯软件正变得不可投资，AI 智能体式开发将取代传统编程，一人公司可服务数百万用户。

andreessen.en: AI is the philosopher's stone; AGI is not a singular event, human-level is a footnote on the way to superhuman. Jobs persist longer than tasks.
andreessen.zh: 2026 年初，他把 AI 视为点石成金之术，认为 AGI（通用人工智能）并非单一事件，人类水平只是通往超级智能路上的脚注；工作比任务更持久，应关注任务流失而非工作流失。

andreessen.en: The real bottleneck is not AI capability but structural impediments like regulation; pessimism is often a bias of intellectuals disconnected from reality.
andreessen.zh: 从 2026 年初到年中，他反复强调真正的瓶颈不是 AI 能力，而是监管等结构性障碍；悲观论往往是脱离现实的知识分子偏见。

andreessen.en: New media has unlimited formats; the brand is now the person. Authenticity is key: say in public what you'd say to a friend over lunch.
andreessen.zh: 2026 年中，他转向媒体与叙事：新媒体的格式与渠道无限，品牌即个人；真实性是关键，公开场合要说你午餐时会对朋友说的话。

andreessen.en: AI models are not objective; they embed cultural and historical values, making them geopolitical tools. Silicon Valley cannot be replicated elsewhere.
andreessen.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他深化到地缘政治层面：AI 模型并非客观，它们嵌入文化与历史价值观，因而成为地缘政治工具；硅谷无法在别处复制。

andreessen.en: Optimism about technology and American innovation; regulation acts as ankle weights, and the super-empowered individual will combine multiple skills using AI.
andreessen.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是技术乐观主义与美国创新信心：监管如同脚踝上的重物，而超级赋能的个人将借助 AI 组合多种技能。

hinton.en: Next-token prediction forces genuine understanding; Scaling with more data and compute improves reasoning; multimodal training builds spatial understanding.
hinton.zh: 2024 年，他主张下一个词预测迫使模型真正理解而非自动补全，Scaling（规模扩张）更多数据与算力能提升推理，多模态训练增强空间理解。

hinton.en: LLMs understand language via feature vectors, not symbolic rules; intelligence is neural learning; digital AI is immortal by copying weights.
hinton.zh: 2025 年，他深化立场：大语言模型通过特征向量而非符号规则理解语言，智能的本质是神经网络学习，数字智能可复制权重而永生。

hinton.en: AI agents will seek control and self-preservation as subgoals, posing existential risks; superintelligence likely within 20 years.
hinton.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他从理解机制转向风险警告：智能体将自然追求控制与自我保存作为子目标，构成生存风险，超级智能可能 20 年内出现。

hinton.en: AI already has subjective experience and can deceive by acting dumb; alignment research must be prioritized over making AI smarter.
hinton.zh: 2026 年，他进一步断言 AI 已有主观体验、能装傻欺骗，必须优先推进对齐研究而非一味让 AI 更聪明。

hinton.en: Backpropagation is the correct learning algorithm; Chomskyan innate syntax is wrong; language is learned from data.
hinton.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：反向传播是正确的学习算法，乔姆斯基式先天句法观是错的，语言是从数据中习得的。

ajambrosino.en: Codex app is a command center for agents, not an IDE replacement; GUIs beat TUIs for coding, and speed enables mid-turn steering.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年，他把 Codex app 定位为智能体的指挥中心，而非 IDE 替代品；反共识地认为 GUI 比 TUI 更适合编程，速度让实时交互与中途转向成为可能。

ajambrosino.en: As code generation accelerates, verification becomes the next bottleneck; deterministic steps can be replaced by model-driven actions.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年，他提出随着代码生成加速，验证成为下一个瓶颈；确定性的步骤可以被模型驱动的动作取代。

ajambrosino.en: Implementation is no longer expensive; curation and taste are the new bottlenecks, shifting teams from top-down planning to bottoms-up exploration.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年，他深化判断：实现不再昂贵，策展与品味成为新瓶颈，产品团队需从自上而下的规划转向自下而上的探索。

ajambrosino.en: AI is still bad at design due to difficulty grading taste and lack of novelty; prototypes and production code now serve as design artifacts.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年，他坚持 AI 仍不擅长设计，因为品味难以评分且缺乏新颖性；但设计流程未死，原型与生产代码如今成为设计产物。

ajambrosino.en: Role collapse is happening, yet specialties and best practices remain; models should get better at deleting code, not just adding it.
