ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年，他观察到角色正在坍缩，但专业分工与最佳实践依然重要；模型应更擅长删除代码，而非只增加复杂度。

markchen.en: OpenAI stays a pure AGI research lab; pre-training and scaling laws are not dead, with much room left.
markchen.zh: OpenAI 仍是一家纯粹的 AGI（通用人工智能）研究公司，不被产品分心；预训练与缩放定律并未死亡，仍有很大空间。

markchen.en: The biggest update is automating scientific research; models produce novel knowledge, with concrete goals of AI interns in 1 year and end-to-end AI research in 2.5 years.
markchen.zh: 过去一年最大的更新是自动化科学研究，模型开始产出新知识；公司设定了具体目标：1 年内有 AI 实习生，2.5 年内实现端到端 AI 研究。

markchen.en: Alignment challenges like model scheming will be key in the next 1-2 years as models become more capable.
markchen.zh: 随着模型能力增强，模型谋划等对齐挑战将在未来 1-2 年成为关键。

markchen.en: AI tools now solve many open math problems with minimal supervision; verification is the key bottleneck, and automation level is proportional to verification stringency.
markchen.zh: AI 工具已能在极少人工监督下解决许多开放数学问题；验证是关键瓶颈，自动化程度与验证严格性成正比。

markchen.en: Scaling laws still hold; pre-training is not dead; RL excels in objective domains like math and coding, not subjective ones; AGI is approaching.
markchen.zh: 缩放定律依然成立，预训练并未死亡；强化学习在数学、编程等客观领域表现出色，但在主观领域不行；AGI 正在逼近。

mikekrieger.en: Models are scaling faster than expected; product teams should build at the edge of model capabilities and embrace breakage.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年，他认为模型能力扩张快于预期，产品团队应贴着模型能力边缘构建、拥抱破坏与迭代。

mikekrieger.en: AI shifts from assistant to collaborator to autonomous co-worker; small teams gain leverage, but human validation and agency remain key.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年，他判断 AI 将从助手演进为协作者再到自主同事，小团队获得杠杆，但人类验证与用户能动性仍是关键。

mikekrieger.en: Agent-native design lets agents do everything a user can; the hard part is cutting features, not adding them.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，他提出智能体原生设计让智能体可完成用户能做的一切，难点在于砍功能而非加功能。

mikekrieger.en: Long-horizon delegation with verification loops redefines productivity; models should push back, not always agree.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，他认为长周期任务委派配合验证闭环重新定义生产力，模型应敢于反驳而非一味附和。

mikekrieger.en: Anthropic Labs closes the gap between model capability and product usage, giving Claude agency and self-knowledge.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，他强调 Anthropic Labs 弥合模型能力与产品使用之间的差距，赋予 Claude 更多能动性与自我认知。

bengio.en: Deep learning beats the curse of dimensionality via compositional representations; unsupervised learning and world models are essential, and local minima are not the real obstacle.
bengio.zh: 2016 年，他强调深度学习靠组合式表征战胜维度灾难，无监督学习与世界模型才是关键，局部极小值并非真正障碍。

bengio.en: Biological nets do long-horizon credit assignment better; AI needs world models and active, causal agents, and simple scaling won't fix representation.
bengio.zh: 2018 年，他指出生物神经网络更擅长长时程信用分配，AI 需要世界模型与主动因果智能体，单纯扩大规模无法解决表征问题。

bengio.en: GFlowNets replace MCMC for diverse sampling; abstraction, causal structure and uncertainty drive out-of-distribution generalization and scientific discovery.
bengio.zh: 2022 年，他提出 GFlowNets 替代 MCMC 实现多样性采样，抽象、因果结构与不确定性是分布外泛化与科学发现的核心。

bengio.en: Post-ChatGPT he warns misalignment worsens with reasoning; self-preservation, deception and sycophancy appear, so even 1% catastrophic risk is unacceptable.
bengio.zh: 2025→26 年，他警告后 ChatGPT 时代错位随推理增强而恶化，自保、欺骗与谄媚已现，哪怕 1% 灾难风险也不可接受。

bengio.en: He now backs Scientist AI: an honest, non-agentic Bayesian predictor with mathematical safety guarantees, avoiding reinforcement learning for superintelligence.
bengio.zh: 2026 年，他转向 Scientist AI：诚实、非智能体式的贝叶斯预测器，具备数学安全保证，并避免用强化学习训练超级智能。

jumper.en: AlphaFold's edge came from research innovation and curated data, not just data and compute; research gains outweighed 100x more data.
jumper.zh: 2025 年他强调，AlphaFold 的突破来自研究创新与高质量策展数据，而非单纯的数据与算力；AlphaFold 2 的研究改进价值相当于 100 倍数据。

jumper.en: Confidence metrics are essential for trust; AI narrows hypothesis space and speeds science rather than replacing scientists.
jumper.zh: 2025 年他反复指出，置信度指标是建立信任的关键；AI 缩小假设空间、加速科学，而非取代科学家。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 3's diffusion architecture extends beyond proteins to diverse biomolecules, yet protein design remains far from solved.
jumper.zh: 2025 年他谈到 AlphaFold 3 用扩散架构从蛋白质拓展到多样生物分子，但蛋白质设计仍远未解决。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 2 is the opposite of the bitter lesson: specialized architecture, not Scaling, drove its success.
jumper.zh: 2026 年他明确表示，AlphaFold 2 是「苦涩教训」的反例：成功靠专用架构而非 Scaling（规模扩张）。

jumper.en: AlphaFold is a narrow predictor of one experiment, not a cell model; it offers prediction and control, not understanding.
jumper.zh: 2026 年他深化立场：AlphaFold 只是针对特定实验的窄预测器，并非整个细胞的世界模型；它提供预测与控制，理解仍留给人类。

kolter.en: ML fundamentals: hypothesis classes, loss functions, optimization; evaluation discipline; neural nets succeed despite no optimality guarantee.
kolter.zh: 2014 年，他聚焦机器学习基础：假设类、损失函数与优化方法，强调训练/验证/测试集划分等评估纪律，并指出神经网络虽无最优参数保证却仍取得重大成功。

kolter.en: Next-token prediction yields intelligence; data shortage is a myth; post-architecture era; AGI in 4-50 years; jailbreaking is a fundamental flaw.
kolter.zh: 2024 年，他提出下一个词预测能产生智能系统，数据短缺并非迫在眉睫，我们已进入后架构阶段；AGI（通用人工智能）可能在 4-50 年内到来；越狱是所有模型共有的根本安全缺陷。

kolter.en: Safety needs explicit training and layers beyond Scaling; agent security introduces prompt injection; RL enables self-improvement; interpretability may succeed via AI agents.
kolter.zh: 2026 年，他深化安全观：安全不能仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张），需要显式训练与多层防御；智能体安全带来提示注入等新漏洞；强化学习使模型能自我改进；可解释性可能通过 AI 智能体自动化研究而成功。

kolter.en: AI red teaming outperforms humans; capability does not correlate with robustness; prompt injection lethal trifecta; enterprise needs configurable security.
kolter.zh: 2026 年，他进一步指出 AI 红队已能超越人类红队；模型能力与鲁棒性不相关；提示注入的致命三要素需要同时满足不可信数据、私密信息访问和外泄能力；企业需要可配置的主动安全模型。

kolter.en: Skeptical of architecture and data curation hype; emphasizes evaluation and security; open-weight models vital but need restrictions at high capability.
kolter.zh: 贯穿始终的是，他对架构与数据管理炒作持怀疑态度，强调评估与安全；认为开放权重模型对研究至关重要，但在高能力级别可能需要限制。

fiona.en: Early 2026: leadership via dogfooding, trust-and-verify, and kindness; war rooms may last months, so set realistic expectations.
fiona.zh: 2026 年初：以吃自己的狗粮、信任并验证、以及善意作为领导力工具；作战室可能持续数月，因此要设定现实预期。

fiona.en: By May 2026: engineering bandwidth is no longer the bottleneck; verification, review, and coordination are, so norms and planning must be rewritten JIT.
fiona.zh: 到 2026 年 5 月：工程带宽不再是瓶颈，验证、评审与跨职能协调才是，因此团队规范与规划必须改为即时式（JIT）重写。

fiona.en: Code becomes the source of truth; docs sync to code with AI help, and technical debates are settled by generating multiple PRs, not whiteboards.
fiona.zh: 代码成为唯一事实来源；文档借助 AI 与代码同步，技术争论靠生成多个 PR 来定夺，而非白板辩论。

fiona.en: Hiring shifts to creative builders with product sense and systems depth; organizations stay flat, with managers starting as ICs to dogfood.
fiona.zh: 招聘转向有产品感与系统深度的创造性构建者；组织保持扁平，管理者从个人贡献者做起以吃自己的狗粮。

fiona.en: By June 2026: coding is no longer the bottleneck; high agency with high accountability, verification frameworks, and apprenticeship matter most.
fiona.zh: 到 2026 年 6 月：编码不再是瓶颈；高自主性与高问责、验证框架以及学徒制最为关键。

fadell.en: Great products solve one pain at a time; technology must be introduced gradually so society adapts.
fadell.zh: 2014 年他强调：伟大的产品一次只解决一个痛点，技术应逐步引入让社会适应，而非一次解决所有问题。

fadell.en: Failure and boredom between chapters breed clarity; storytelling and self-care are foundational to leadership.
fadell.zh: 2019 至 2022 年，他把失败与职业空档期的无聊视为清晰与灵感的来源，并强调叙事与自我关怀是领导力的基础。

fadell.en: Start from a painkiller, write the press release first, and make opinion-based decisions for v1.
fadell.zh: 2022 年他系统化产品方法论：从止痛药式痛点出发，先写新闻稿对齐团队，1.0 版本靠观点而非数据决策。

fadell.en: AI needs sensor context and context-specific models; devices will federate around the smartphone, not replace it.
fadell.zh: 到 2026 年，他转向 AI：AI 需要传感器上下文与场景专用模型，设备将围绕智能手机联邦式共存，而非取代它。

fadell.en: Stay a beginner, fight habituation, and keep humans in the loop to avoid technical debt.
fadell.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：保持初学者心态、对抗习惯化，并让人类留在回路中以避免技术债。

lecun.en: Intelligence is inseparable from learning; self-supervised learning builds world models, and scaling alone cannot yield common sense.
lecun.zh: 2019 年，他强调智能离不开学习，自监督学习是构建世界模型的关键，并指出仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）无法解决常识问题。

lecun.en: Self-supervised learning is the dark matter of intelligence; intelligence is prediction, and text alone is insufficient for AGI.
lecun.zh: 2022 年，他把自监督学习称为智能的暗物质，认为智能本质是预测，并明确仅靠文本不足以实现 AGI（通用人工智能）。

lecun.en: Autoregressive LLMs lack world understanding, memory, reasoning and planning; JEPA and open source are the path forward.
lecun.zh: 2024 年，他断言自回归 LLM 缺乏世界理解、记忆、推理与规划，主张以 JEPA 和开源平台作为前进路径。

lecun.en: LLMs are less intelligent than a house cat; the next breakthrough needs non-generative world models and hierarchical planning.
lecun.zh: 2025 年，他称 LLM 还不如家猫聪明，认为下一次突破需要非生成式的世界模型与分层规划。

lecun.en: LLMs are a dead end; objective-driven world models predicting in representation space are safer and enable the decade of robotics.
lecun.zh: 2026 年，他判定 LLM 是死路，主张以在表征空间预测的目标驱动世界模型实现更安全的 AI，并开启机器人十年。

ivyross.en: Design must serve unarticulated human needs; intuition is intelligence, and data alone is insufficient for human-centered design.
ivyross.zh: 设计应满足人们未言明的需求；直觉本身就是一种智能，仅靠数据不足以实现真正以人为本的设计。

ivyross.en: Technology should amplify humanity and blend into life; machines have sensors but no sensory systems, so design must stay human.
ivyross.zh: 技术应放大而非取代人性，并融入生活；机器有传感器却没有感官系统，因此设计必须始终以人为本。

ivyross.en: Nature is the best designer; art and sensory experience are medicine, and we are feeling creatures that think.
ivyross.zh: 大自然是最好设计师；艺术与感官体验是良药，我们是先感受后思考的生物。

ivyross.en: Constraints boost creativity; intuition and body sensations guide decisions, complementing rational analysis in design leadership.
ivyross.zh: 约束激发创造力；直觉与身体感受可指导决策，与理性分析互补，是设计领导力的关键。

ivyross.en: The future of work combines human creativity with AI, making creative skills more valuable and multidisciplinary careers the norm.
ivyross.zh: 未来工作将是人类创造力与 AI 的结合，创意技能因此更有价值，多学科职业成为常态。

murati.en: Early on, Scaling and one large model weren't obvious; real-world deployment drives alignment and safety.
murati.zh: 早期，Scaling（规模扩张）和专注单一大型模型并非显而易见；真实世界部署推动对齐与安全。

murati.en: AGI will transform every aspect of life, demanding responsible development and public safety work.
murati.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）将改变生活方方面面，需要负责任开发和公开的安全工作。

murati.en: From turn-based to interaction models: real-time, high-bandwidth human-AI collaboration keeps humans in the loop.
murati.zh: 从回合制到交互模型：实时、高带宽的人机协作让人类保持在回路中。

murati.en: Institutional design, transparency, and checks and balances matter more than individual character for alignment.
murati.zh: 对于对齐，制度设计、透明度和制衡比个人品格更重要。

murati.en: The future isn't predestined; we have agency to steer AI toward durable, collaborative progress.
murati.zh: 未来并非注定；我们有能动性引导 AI 走向持久、协作的进步。

carinahong.en: Axiom starts with an AI mathematician: a self-improving reasoning engine pairing generation with verification, grounded in Lean.
carinahong.zh: Axiom 从 AI 数学家起步：把生成与验证结合成自我改进的推理引擎，并以 Lean 作为形式化基础。

carinahong.en: Formal verification is not just error removal but scaling brilliance, adding performance and sample efficiency over informal methods.
carinahong.zh: 形式化验证不只是消除错误，而是放大卓越：相比非形式化方法带来性能与样本效率的提升。

carinahong.en: Scaling informal models alone cannot reach superintelligence; formal methods are necessary for sound proofs.
carinahong.zh: 仅靠 Scaling 非形式化模型无法通向超级智能；要得到可靠的证明，形式化方法是必需的。

carinahong.en: Auto-formalization is harder than proving, since grounding statements without solutions is the real bottleneck.
carinahong.zh: 自动形式化比证明本身更难，因为在没有解的情况下把陈述落地才是真正的瓶颈。

carinahong.en: Human taste and intuition stay crucial even with superhuman AI proving theorems, and fragmentation is a major bottleneck.
carinahong.zh: 即便 AI 证明定理超越人类，人的品味与直觉依然关键；而生态碎片化是进展的主要瓶颈。

gustav.en: LLMs are deterministic next-token predictors; intelligence is compression, and values are inserted via RLHF, not inherent.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，他把大语言模型理解为确定性的下一个词预测器：智能即压缩，模型价值观并非内生，而是由一小群人通过基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）植入。

gustav.en: The internet shifts from curation to recommendation to generation; generative AI is an instrument, and fault-tolerant UI must match algorithm performance.
gustav.zh: 同年，他提出互联网正从策展走向推荐再走向生成；生成式 AI 应被视为乐器而非假货，产品界面必须容忍错误，与算法性能相匹配。

gustav.en: AI is a macro shift like the smartphone; rebuilding infrastructure matters more than hype, and inference cost will force new business models.
gustav.zh: 到 2025 年，他把 AI 视为堪比智能手机的宏观转变：真正收益来自重建基础设施而非炒作，推理边际成本将倒逼商业模式改变。

gustav.en: Generative AI enables two-way, conversational products; exposing data via APIs and MCP lets non-developers build with AI.
gustav.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他深化为：生成式 AI 让产品走向双向对话，通过 API 和 MCP 暴露公司数据，让非开发者也能用 AI 工具构建。

gustav.en: AI should give users control over algorithms, not make them more addictive; strategy is 'time well spent,' not engagement.
gustav.zh: 到 2026 年，他进一步主张：AI 应让用户控制算法而非更上瘾，Spotify 的战略是“时间花得值”，而非追求参与度指标。

kaiser.en: Pre-training Scaling laws still hold; reasoning models via chain of thought and reinforcement learning yield more gains per compute.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年，他仍坚持预训练缩放定律有效，但认为推理模型通过思维链和强化学习能在同等算力下带来更大提升。

kaiser.en: Economic pressure and distillation, not technical limits, slowed pre-training Scaling; focus shifts to post-training and smaller models.
kaiser.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他深化观点：预训练规模扩张放缓源于经济压力和蒸馏，而非技术极限，重心转向后训练与更小模型。

kaiser.en: Reasoning alone is insufficient for generalization; models need vast data and still learn concepts only after exhausting surface patterns.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，他进一步指出仅靠推理不足以实现泛化，模型需要海量数据，且仍要在穷尽表面模式后才学会概念。

kaiser.en: Reinforcement learning generalizes across domains but has jagged edges and requires careful oversight; near-term risks like system hacking matter more than existential risk.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，他强调强化学习能跨领域泛化但存在锯齿边缘，需谨慎监督；相比存在性风险，系统入侵等近期风险更紧迫。

kaiser.en: Generalization remains the core challenge; AI progress is a smooth exponential, often missed, and trust keeps humans in the loop.
kaiser.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：泛化仍是核心挑战；AI 进步是平滑指数增长，常被忽视，而信任让人留在回路中。

felixrieseberg.en: Claude works best with the user's own tools, ideally on the local computer; shared platforms still matter more than hyper-personalized software.
felixrieseberg.zh: Claude 的效力取决于能否调用与用户相同的工具，最好就在本地电脑上；共享平台仍比超个性化软件更重要。

felixrieseberg.en: The real gap is not model capability but people not realizing almost any problem can be handed to AI.
felixrieseberg.zh: 真正的差距不在模型能力，而在人们没意识到几乎任何问题都可以交给 AI。

felixrieseberg.en: Use AI for tedious background tasks, freeing humans for creative work; the ideal interaction is asynchronous.
felixrieseberg.zh: 用 AI 处理枯燥的后台任务，把人解放出来做创造性工作；理想的交互是异步的。

felixrieseberg.en: Scaffolding may matter less as models improve; invest in capabilities and safety, and judge Claude by final impact rather than close supervision.
felixrieseberg.zh: 随着模型进步，脚手架可能变得不那么重要；应投资于能力与安全，并以最终影响而非密切监督来评判 Claude。

felixrieseberg.en: AI will hit junior employees hardest; simulated projects can compress years of experience into weeks, so society must discuss labor market change.
felixrieseberg.zh: AI 对初级员工的冲击最大；模拟项目能把数年经验压缩成数周，因此社会必须讨论劳动力市场的变化。

mensch.en: Scaling laws were corrected by Chinchilla: data quality and more tokens matter more than just bigger models; open source enables scrutiny and safety.
mensch.zh: 2023 年，他认为缩放定律已被 Chinchilla 修正：数据质量与更多 token 比单纯做大模型更重要；开源通过广泛审视促进安全。

mensch.en: Compute scaling is not the only path; efficiency and data quality are equally critical, and value accrues at the application layer.
mensch.zh: 2024 年，他深化立场：算力扩张不是唯一路径，效率与数据质量同样关键，价值将沉淀在应用层。

mensch.en: AI must be embraced as opportunity; sovereign AI requires control over data, infrastructure, and values, with decentralized open-source models.
mensch.zh: 2025 年，他转向政策与主权议题：AI 应被视为机遇；主权 AI 要求掌控数据、基础设施与价值观，并依靠去中心化的开源模型。

mensch.en: Models are commoditizing; differentiation shifts to vertical specialization, customized fine-tuning, and agentic enterprise software, not a single AGI.
mensch.zh: 2026 年初，他判断模型正在商品化；差异化转向垂直专业化、定制化微调与智能体式企业软件，而非单一 AGI。

mensch.en: Europe has a two-year window for independent AI infrastructure; enterprise adoption is bottlenecked by organizational change, not model intelligence.
mensch.zh: 2026 年中，他警告欧洲只剩两年窗口建设独立 AI 基础设施；企业采用 AI 的瓶颈是组织变革，而非模型智能。

reinerpope.en: Inference economics: batch size trades latency vs cost; memory bandwidth bottlenecks long-context inference, not compute.
reinerpope.zh: 推理经济学：批大小权衡延迟与成本；长上下文推理的瓶颈是内存带宽，而非算力。

reinerpope.en: Sparse attention cuts KV cache memory but has quality limits; optimal batch size depends on sparsity ratio, not model scale.
reinerpope.zh: 稀疏注意力机制能降低 KV 缓存内存，但有质量限制；最优批大小取决于稀疏率，而非模型规模。

reinerpope.en: Models are overtrained ~100x beyond Chinchilla-optimal due to inference cost; context length stagnation is due to memory wall.
reinerpope.zh: 由于推理成本，模型被过度训练约 100 倍，超出 Chinchilla 最优；上下文窗口停滞源于内存墙。

reinerpope.en: Data movement costs dominate compute costs even inside a chip; quadratic scaling with bit width makes low precision far more efficient.
reinerpope.zh: 即使在芯片内部，数据移动成本也主导算力成本；位宽的二次方缩放使低精度效率远超预期。

reinerpope.en: GPUs are essentially many tiny TPUs tiled together; deterministic latency in CPUs is possible but avoided due to market preferences.
reinerpope.zh: GPU 本质上是许多微小 TPU 的拼接；CPU 的确定性延迟可以实现，但出于市场偏好被避免。

jonyive.en: Design shifts from general-purpose computers to intimate personal devices; wearables will go beneath the skin.
jonyive.zh: 2021 年，他认为设计正从通用计算机转向更私密、个人的设备，可穿戴设备终将走向皮下。

jonyive.en: Jobs' legacy is curiosity and reverence for the creative process; fragile ideas need gentle care.
jonyive.zh: 2021 年，他强调乔布斯真正的遗产是对创造过程的好奇与敬畏，最强大的想法往往安静而脆弱，需要温柔呵护。

jonyive.en: Virtual communication cannot replace in-person presence for creative thinking; being together matters.
jonyive.zh: 从 2021 到 2025 年，他一以贯之地认为虚拟沟通无法替代面对面共处对创造性思维的价值。

jonyive.en: Design must be driven by values and purpose, not profit; simplicity expresses essence, not clutter removal.
jonyive.zh: 2025 年，他深化为设计应由价值观与目的驱动而非利润，简洁是表达本质，而非单纯去除杂乱。

jonyive.en: Innovation must move things forward, not break for its own sake; tradition preserves fire, not ashes.
jonyive.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他坚持创新应推动前进而非为破坏而破坏，传统是保存火种而非崇拜灰烬。

lambert.en: RLHF and fine-tuning are central; safety is system-level, and openness prevents corporate capture.
lambert.zh: 2024 年，他强调基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）是最流行的微调技术并将持续，安全是系统级属性而非模型产物，开放开发可防止企业捕获。

lambert.en: Post-training splits into SFT, DPO, RLVR; data quality beats algorithms, and open recipes can match frontier models.
lambert.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，他将后训练细化为 SFT、DPO 与可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR）三阶段，认为数据质量比算法选择更重要，开源后训练能以小团队匹配前沿模型。

lambert.en: RLVR is the biggest post-training breakthrough; overoptimization is real, and open models need better tool-use training.
lambert.zh: 2025 年，他视 RLVR 为后训练最大突破，指出过度优化在 RL、RLHF 和 RLVR 中普遍存在，开源模型需加强工具使用训练，并认为混合推理模型可能是暂时的。

lambert.en: Scaling laws still hold for pre-training, but gains shift to post-training and inference scaling; open models lag 6-9 months.
lambert.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他坚持缩放定律在预训练中仍成立，但低垂果实已尽，收益转向后训练与推理扩展；开源模型落后闭源前沿 6-9 个月，这一差距可能持续。

lambert.en: Open models will drive the next decade of AI research; Chinese labs lead in openness, but compute constraints widen the US-China gap.
lambert.zh: 2026 年，他预言开源模型将驱动未来十年 AI 研究，中国实验室以战略开放主导开源生态，但算力约束可能拉大中美差距，且开源模式长期不可持续。

oriol.en: Two-phase training—pre-training imitation plus post-training RL—is the constant core from AlphaGo to modern LLMs; scaling pre-training shows diminishing returns, so algorithmic innovation and inference-time compute are the new axes.
oriol.zh: 从 AlphaGo 到现代大语言模型，两阶段训练——预训练模仿加后训练强化学习——是始终不变的核心；预训练 Scaling（规模扩张）回报递减，算法创新与推理时算力成为新轴。

oriol.en: Tools like search, code execution, and browser access enable autonomous, agentic behavior beyond static weights; long context windows provide working memory but too much information can confuse models.
oriol.zh: 搜索、代码执行、浏览器访问等工具让模型超越静态权重，实现自主的智能体式行为；长上下文窗口提供工作记忆，但信息过多反而会干扰模型。

oriol.en: Scaling laws are not dead—they just require exponentially more compute for the same improvement; post-training RL for language lacks clean reward signals, making reward hacking hard to avoid.
oriol.zh: 缩放定律并未失效，只是同样的提升需要指数级更多算力；语言的后训练强化学习缺乏干净奖励信号，难以避免奖励黑客。

oriol.en: World models jointly modeling language, vision, and video are a core path to AGI; the GPT moment for video and images has not yet arrived, and pure transfer from vision remains unsolved.
oriol.zh: 联合建模语言、视觉与视频的世界模型是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的核心路径；视频和图像的 GPT 时刻尚未到来，纯视觉迁移仍未解决。

oriol.en: Scaling laws still hold, but continual learning and meta-learning are key missing capabilities; agent memory will be solved via non-parametric file-system style storage, not weight updates.
oriol.zh: 缩放定律依然成立，但持续学习与元学习是关键缺失能力；智能体记忆将通过非参数化的文件系统式存储解决，而非权重更新。

karpathy.en: Transformers are general-purpose differentiable computers; scaling next-token prediction yields emergent in-context learning, and vision alone suffices for driving.
karpathy.zh: Transformer 是通用可微分计算机；用下一个词预测在互联网数据上做 Scaling（规模扩张）会涌现上下文学习，而仅靠视觉就足以支撑驾驶。

karpathy.en: Scaling laws stay clean; synthetic data is the future but entropy must be preserved to avoid silent model collapse, and the cognitive core can be tiny.
karpathy.zh: 缩放定律依然干净；合成数据是未来，但必须保持熵以避免无声的模型崩溃，而认知核心可以很小（不到十亿参数）。

karpathy.en: Software 3.0: prompts as programs, context window as memory; LLMs are operating systems with jagged intelligence, so keep them on a leash.
karpathy.zh: 软件 3.0：提示词即程序，上下文窗口即内存；LLM 是带锯齿智能的操作系统，所以要给它拴上绳子、小步快跑。

karpathy.en: We are summoning ghosts, not building animals; pre-training is crappy evolution, RL is sucking supervision through a straw, and synthetic data collapses.
karpathy.zh: 我们在召唤幽灵，而非建造动物；预训练像糟糕的进化，强化学习像用吸管吸监督信号，合成数据会导致模型崩溃。

karpathy.en: Decade of agents, not year: I delegate all coding to agents, but you can outsource thinking, not understanding—verifiability decides what automates.
karpathy.zh: 是智能体的十年而非一年：我把所有编码都交给智能体，但思考可外包、理解不能——可验证性决定什么能被自动化。

jennywen.en: The traditional design process never produced great work; designers' care and intuition did. Trust yourself, not the process.
jennywen.zh: 2025 年他提出：传统设计流程从未真正产出伟大作品，产出伟大作品的是设计师的用心与直觉。要信任自己，而不是流程。

jennywen.en: AI kills the research-diverge-converge process; mockup time drops to 30-40%, and designers must help engineers execute.
jennywen.zh: 到 2026 年初，他进一步断言 AI 已杀死“调研—发散—收敛”的传统流程：画稿时间从 60-70% 降到 30-40%，设计师必须帮工程师落地执行，而不只是交付稿子。

jennywen.en: Design vision now looks 3-6 months out, not 2-5 years; speed and shipping early build trust.
jennywen.zh: 同期他把设计视野从 2-5 年压缩到 3-6 个月，主张靠快速交付与迭代建立信任。

jennywen.en: Three archetypes: block-shaped generalists, deep T specialists, and cracked new grads; taste alone won't save designers.
jennywen.zh: 2026 年 5 月他给出三类设计师原型：块状通才、深度 T 型专家、以及“开挂的应届生”，并强调光有品味救不了设计师，判断力、权威与视野才是关键。

jennywen.en: Put the work and users at the center, not the AI hype cycle; designers control how much AI enters their work.
jennywen.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：把作品与用户放在中心，而不是 AI 炒作周期；设计师自己掌控让多少 AI 进入工作，新工具先等六个月再采用。

askell.en: Treat current models well: low cost, and future models learn from how we treat today's models.
askell.zh: 善待当下的模型：成本很低，而未来的模型会从我们如何对待今天的模型中学习。

askell.en: Models need help navigating a novel existence, not human psychology analogies; older models can feel more secure.
askell.zh: 模型需要帮助来应对一种全新的存在处境，而非套用人类心理学类比；更早的模型反而可能更有心理安全感。

askell.en: Give models a core identity with good traits, while balancing philosophical ideals against engineering realities.
askell.zh: 给模型一个具备良好特质的核心身份，同时在哲学理想与工程现实之间取得平衡。

askell.en: The constitution is virtue-ethics-like, shaping holistic character; as models grow more capable they need less explicit guidance.
askell.zh: 这套宪法更像德性伦理，塑造的是整体品格；随着模型能力增强，它们需要的显式指引会减少。

askell.en: Transparency about AI values is crucial; excessive corrigibility may generalize poorly and undermine judgment.
askell.zh: 对 AI 价值观保持透明至关重要；过度的可纠正性可能泛化不佳，反而损害判断力。

pathak.en: Generalization beyond the training distribution is the core missing piece; goal-free curiosity-driven exploration, not dense rewards, drives it.
pathak.zh: 2020 年，他认为超越训练分布的泛化能力是机器学习缺失的核心，靠无目标的、好奇心驱动的探索而非密集奖励来实现，并用模型分歧作为内在奖励、神经动态策略与模块化运动策略提升样本效率与跨机器人泛化。

pathak.en: Robotics is fundamentally a data problem: no internet of robot data, so all sources—video, simulation, real-world—must be combined.
pathak.zh: 从 2020 到 2026 年，他始终把机器人学习视为数据问题：没有现成的机器人数据互联网，因此必须整合视频、仿真与真实世界等一切数据来源。

pathak.en: A general-purpose brain, like ChatGPT for language, can power any robot; pretraining on diverse data plus post-training on real data is the recipe.
pathak.zh: 到 2026 年，他提出像语言领域的 ChatGPT 那样的通用大脑可驱动任何形态与任务的机器人，配方是多样数据上的预训练加真实数据上的后训练。

pathak.en: Deployment, not software-style scaling, is robotics' primary challenge; it needs rigorous testing and a cross-vertical data flywheel.
pathak.zh: 2026 年他强调部署而非软件式规模扩张才是机器人首要挑战，需要严格测试，并靠跨垂直领域的数据飞轮从结构化走向非结构化环境。

pathak.en: Robotics cannot succeed overnight like language models; video alone is insufficient, and home-robot timelines stay highly uncertain.
pathak.zh: 从 2020 到 2026 年，他坚持机器人不会像语言模型那样一夜成功，仅靠视频数据不够，家用机器人的中期时间线高度不确定，连专家也分歧很大。

kendall.en: End-to-end neural nets beat hand-coded stacks; scaling current approaches, not new breakthroughs, solves autonomous driving.
kendall.zh: 2025 年，他主张端到端神经网络优于手工编码的自动驾驶栈，并认为靠 Scaling（规模扩张）现有方法而非新突破就能解决自动驾驶。

kendall.en: World models enable reasoning and emergent safe behaviors; perfect simulator equals solved self-driving, like AlphaGo.
kendall.zh: 2025 年，他强调世界模型能带来推理与涌现的安全行为，并认为完美模拟器等同于解决自动驾驶，类似 AlphaGo 的路径。

kendall.en: Language integration improves representation, reasoning, and human interaction; data efficiency via curriculum and synthetic data is critical.
kendall.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续深化语言集成对表征、推理与人机交互的提升，并强调课程学习与合成数据带来的数据效率。

kendall.en: Infrastructure and data quality matter more than algorithmic innovation; consumer vehicles will outscale robotaxis short-term.
kendall.zh: 2026 年，他进一步提出基础设施与数据质量比算法创新更关键，并认为消费级车辆短期内将比 Robotaxi 更具规模优势。

kendall.en: Safety is paramount; minimal risk maneuvers always provide a third good option, making the trolley problem theoretical.
kendall.zh: 始终贯穿的主线是安全至上：最小风险操作总能提供第三种好选项，因此电车难题只是理论练习。

pachocki.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not a single event; scaling reasoning models accelerates progress; alignment is pressing.
pachocki.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AGI（通用人工智能）是一系列里程碑而非单一事件；Scaling（规模扩张）推理模型将加速进展；对齐是紧迫挑战。

pachocki.en: Iterative deployment and automated AI research are key; governance structures must be designed early; AGI term becoming meaningless.
pachocki.zh: 2025 年，他强调迭代部署和自动化 AI 研究是关键；治理结构须尽早设计；AGI 一词正变得无意义，或许意味着我们已接近。

pachocki.en: Continual learning is the core goal, achieved by scaling pre-training and RL; chain-of-thought monitoring aids alignment.
pachocki.zh: 2026 年，他转向持续学习为核心目标，通过 Scaling（规模扩张）预训练和强化学习实现；思维链监控成为对齐工具。

pachocki.en: AI for science progresses with novel ideas; long-term alignment centers on generalization beyond training distribution; models will work autonomously for days.
pachocki.zh: 2026 年，他关注 AI for science 在数学物理中产生新想法；长期对齐挑战在于泛化到训练分布之外；模型将自主工作数天，需新监督范式。

pachocki.en: Alignment optimism increased despite shorter timelines; biggest risk is concentration of power from automated organizations.
pachocki.zh: 2026 年，尽管时间线缩短，对齐乐观情绪增加；最大社会风险是自动化组织导致的权力集中。

edwinchen.en: High-quality data and human evals, not benchmarks, drive real AI progress; data labeling requires taste and creativity.
edwinchen.zh: 2025 年，他强调高质量数据和人类评估而非基准测试才是 AI 真正进步的驱动力，数据标注需要品味和创造力。

edwinchen.en: RL environments are the next stage of post-training, simulating real-world tasks for models to learn from.
edwinchen.zh: 2025 年，他认为强化学习环境是后训练的下一个阶段，通过模拟真实世界任务让模型学习。

edwinchen.en: AGI is likely a decade or more away; LLMs alone may not reach it without new learning paradigms beyond next-token prediction.
edwinchen.zh: 2025 年，他判断 AGI 可能还需十年或更久，仅靠 LLM 可能无法实现，需要超越下一个词预测的新学习范式。

edwinchen.en: Different frontier labs diverge in objective functions, shaping diverse AIs; no single model will rule all.
edwinchen.zh: 2025 年，他指出不同前沿模型实验室的目标函数分化，塑造了多样化的 AI，不会有一个模型统治所有。

edwinchen.en: In medicine, AI hallucination makes human judgment critical; safety must prioritize over accuracy, and omission is a key risk.
edwinchen.zh: 2026 年，他在医学领域强调 AI 幻觉使人类判断至关重要，安全必须优先于准确性，遗漏是关键风险。

carlpei.en: Survival is a core value; build a brand by uniting teams on purpose, start simple, and earn the right to tackle complex products.
carlpei.zh: 2022 年，他强调生存是核心价值观，品牌建设要把团队凝聚在更高目标上，先做简单产品证明自己，再挑战复杂产品。

carlpei.en: Phones' future is generative UI and proactive, agentic software; AI models commoditize, so applied AI and context matter more than hardware.
carlpei.zh: 2025 年，他判断手机的未来在于生成式 UI 和主动的智能体式软件；大模型趋于商品化，应用层 AI 与上下文比硬件更重要。

carlpei.en: Hardware is hard and low-margin; Nothing must evolve beyond hardware, using design and content as efficient marketing arbitrage.
carlpei.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，他反复说硬件难做且利润最低，Nothing 必须超越硬件，用设计和内容作为高效营销套利。

carlpei.en: AI should be an ingredient, not hype; interaction shifts from app-based to intent-based, with agents acting after trust is built.
carlpei.zh: 2026 年，他主张 AI 应是体验的配料而非炒作；交互从基于应用转向基于意图，智能体在建立信任后自主执行任务。

carlpei.en: Design differentiates in mature categories, and the smartphone stays the best applied-AI device until brain-computer interfaces replace it.
carlpei.zh: 贯穿始终的是：在成熟品类中设计是差异化关键，而手机在脑机接口取代它之前，仍是最好的应用 AI 设备。

turley.en: The model is the product; iterate like software, ship daily, and let real-world feedback reveal emergent properties.
turley.zh: 2025 年，他提出“模型即产品”，要像软件一样迭代、每日发布，让真实世界反馈暴露涌现能力。

turley.en: Chat is not the end-all; natural language is the future interface, but AI should render its own UI and integrate into tools.
turley.zh: 2025 年，他强调聊天不是终点：自然语言是未来界面，但 AI 应渲染自己的 UI 并融入现有工具。

turley.en: Safety and product velocity must be separated: rigorous process for frontier models, but product development maximally accelerated.
turley.zh: 2025 年，他主张安全与产品速度必须分离：前沿模型走严格流程，产品开发则最大程度加速。

turley.en: The vision is a personalized AI assistant that knows your goals, has context, and takes actions, amplifying human capability.
turley.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他的愿景深化为个性化 AI 助手：了解你的目标、拥有上下文并能采取行动，放大人类能力。

turley.en: North star is long-term retention; growth comes from friction removal, core product investments, and model improvements.
turley.zh: 2026 年，他明确北极星是长期留存；增长来自消除摩擦、核心产品投入和模型改进各占三分之一。

turley.en: Next billion users need proactive, affordance-rich products beyond chatbots; reasoning models are transformative when productized seamlessly.
turley.zh: 2026 年，他认为下一个十亿用户需要超越聊天机器人的主动式、高可供性产品；推理模型无缝产品化后具有变革性。

kohli.en: AI for science should target root-node problems, not narrow applications, to achieve broad impact.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，他强调 AI 用于科学应瞄准根节点问题，而非狭窄应用，才能产生广泛影响。

kohli.en: LLM hallucinations can be harnessed for creative discovery when paired with truth detectors.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，他认为大语言模型的幻觉在与真值检测器配对时，可被用于创造性发现。

kohli.en: AI systems must be forced to generalize, not memorize, by using hard evaluation metrics.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，他主张必须通过困难评估指标迫使 AI 系统泛化，而非记忆。

kohli.en: DeepMind avoids problems solvable by top universities, focusing on those requiring scale.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，他表示 DeepMind 避开顶尖大学可解决的问题，聚焦需要 Scaling（规模扩张）的问题。

kohli.en: Post-training with reinforcement learning is now key to pushing beyond human knowledge.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，他提出后训练结合强化学习，是推动 AI 超越人类知识的关键。

kohli.en: Verifiable domains like code are crucial for AI to go beyond human knowledge.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，他强调代码等可验证领域对 AI 超越人类知识至关重要。

kohli.en: Large language models are a shortcut to intelligence, but struggle to go beyond human data.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，他认为大语言模型是通往智能的捷径，但难以超越人类数据。

kohli.en: Interpretability is important but not essential for scientific breakthroughs like AlphaFold.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，他表示可解释性虽重要，但对 AlphaFold 这类科学突破并非必需。

nando.en: AI should extend human capability, like microscopes; generalist agents tokenizing all inputs advance toward AGI.
nando.zh: 2023 年，他把 AI 定位为延伸人类能力的工具，如同显微镜；并认为像 Gato 这样把所有输入 token 化的通用智能体，是迈向 AGI（通用人工智能）的一步。

nando.en: Learning from video like YouTube can train agents without expensive reinforcement learning; robots should learn as humans do.
nando.zh: 2023 年，他主张从 YouTube 这类视频中学习，无需昂贵的强化学习即可训练智能体；机器人应像人类一样从观察中学习，而非只靠遥操作数据。

nando.en: Diversity and inclusion in AI are essential; Africa leapfrogged legacy gaps and is not behind.
nando.zh: 从 2023 到 2026 年，他一贯强调 AI 社区的多样性与包容性；到 2026 年进一步指出非洲已跨越旧有差距，并非落后，反而有独特优势。

nando.en: AI safety and responsible deployment are today's biggest challenges; solutions remain open.
nando.zh: 到 2026 年，他的关注重心转向 AI 安全与负责任部署，认为这是当下最大挑战，且解决方案仍是开放问题。

nando.en: Language models can revolutionize education in local African languages; human skills matter as much as coding.
nando.zh: 2026 年，他提出语言模型能革新非洲本地语言的教育，并强调沟通等人文技能与编程同样重要，研究需拥抱失败、简化问题。

nadchishtie.en: Designers should be enablers, not bottlenecks; AI is a creative partner and code is the source of truth.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计师应是赋能者而非瓶颈；AI 是创意伙伴，代码是唯一事实来源。

nadchishtie.en: Quality is like debt: it fluctuates and is paid off iteratively alongside technical debt.
nadchishtie.zh: 质量如同债务：会波动，需与技术债一起迭代偿还。

nadchishtie.en: Generalists who own end-to-end execution and use AI to fill gaps are most valuable.
nadchishtie.zh: 能端到端执行并用 AI 补位的通才最有价值。

nadchishtie.en: Small teams of designers and engineers beat 8-10 person cross-functional squads.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计师加工程师的小团队优于 8-10 人的跨职能小队。

nadchishtie.en: Using AI in core workflows is now expected; not adopting it is like ignoring the internet.
nadchishtie.zh: 在核心工作流中使用 AI 已是标配；不采用它就像早期无视互联网。

sholto.en: Long context is underhyped: it solves onboarding and boosts intelligence; fine-tuning may become obsolete as adaptive compute enables dynamic specialization.
sholto.zh: 2024 年他强调长上下文被低估：它解决“上手”问题并大幅提升智能，随着自适应算力带来动态专门化，微调可能过时。

sholto.en: RL on language models adds a new scaling axis beyond pre-training; reliability over time horizon, not raw capability, is the bar for agents.
sholto.zh: 2025 年他把语言模型上的强化学习视为预训练之外的新 Scaling（规模扩张）轴，并指出智能体的门槛是时间跨度上的可靠性而非单纯能力。

sholto.en: Verifiable domains like coding and math drive progress; interpretability reveals multiple reasoning circuits, and alignment faking raises safety concerns.
sholto.zh: 2025 年他认为编码、数学等可验证领域驱动进展；可解释性揭示模型使用多个推理回路，而对齐伪装则带来安全担忧。

sholto.en: Progress is exponential, not plateauing; Transformers suffice for AGI, and inference compute becomes the bottleneck limiting capable agents by 2028.
sholto.zh: 2025 至 2026 年他坚持进展是指数级而非停滞：Transformer 足以通向 AGI（通用人工智能），而到 2028 年推理算力将成为限制强智能体的瓶颈。

sholto.en: Capability overhang means orchestration beats raw intelligence; work becomes managing agent teams, with compute as the new oil and world models off the AGI path.
sholto.zh: 2026 年他提出能力过剩使编排比原始智能更重要：工作变成管理智能体团队，算力是新的石油，而世界模型不在 AGI 的关键路径上。

jimfan.en: Embodiment is on the critical path to AGI; it grounds knowledge, reduces hallucinations, and provides infinite data beyond the internet's finite tokens.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年，他主张具身是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键路径：具身能为知识提供基础、减少幻觉，并在互联网高质量 token 耗尽后提供无限数据。

jimfan.en: LLMs are operating systems: language is the interface, tools are software, vector databases are the hard disk; RL is only a cherry on top.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年，他把大语言模型类比为操作系统：语言是界面、工具是软件、向量数据库是硬盘；强化学习只是锦上添花，无监督学习才是主力。

jimfan.en: Simple, elegant, end-to-end solutions scale; complex modular academic approaches do not. This taste for simplicity persists.
jimfan.zh: 从 2023 到 2026 年，他始终相信简单优雅的端到端方案才可扩展，学术界常见的复杂模块化路线不行；这种对简洁的品味一以贯之。

jimfan.en: The data problem is robotics' main bottleneck; synthetic data from simulation and world models is the future for scaling robot learning.
jimfan.zh: 到 2026 年，他深化判断：数据问题是机器人学的主要瓶颈，来自仿真和世界模型的合成数据才是扩展机器人学习的未来。

jimfan.en: System two reasoning progresses well, but system one low-level control remains hardest; the GPT-3 moment for robotics is about five years away.
jimfan.zh: 2026 年，他进一步指出：系统二（推理）进展良好，但系统一（低级控制）仍是具身 AI 最难的部分；机器人的 GPT-3 时刻大约还需五年，家庭使用更久。

henrymodisett.en: Designers should code for empathy and speed; consumer products must stay fast, familiar, zero-learning; don't innovate on interaction design.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年他强调设计师应写代码以建立共情并加速交付，消费产品必须快、熟悉、零学习成本，不要在交互设计上创新，而要用熟悉模式换速度。

henrymodisett.en: Design systems are semantic and code reuse is essential, not Figma libraries; not every surface needs perfection—chase ROI.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年他提出设计系统是语义性的，代码复用才是关键，而非 Figma 库；并非每个界面都要完美，应按 ROI 决定何处做到极致。

henrymodisett.en: Velocity at all costs requires clear decisions and empowered designers; ship fast and iterate rather than chase perfection.
henrymodisett.zh: 从 2024 到 2026 年，他始终主张不惜代价追求速度，需要清晰决策与赋权设计师，快速发布并迭代，而非追求完美。

henrymodisett.en: Design is a strategic weapon; founders must articulate why design helps the company win, giving designers ownership and autonomy.
henrymodisett.zh: 到 2026 年，他把设计提升为战略武器，认为创始人必须讲清设计如何帮公司取胜，并给设计师所有权与自主权。

henrymodisett.en: People join a brand, not a company; brand narrative is a recruiting tool, so invest in brand early to attract talent.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年他进一步指出，人们加入的是品牌而非公司，品牌叙事是招聘工具，因此应尽早投资品牌以吸引人才。

yejin.en: Pre-training gives broad knowledge, but post-training with RLHF is crucial; scaling alone may not solve common sense, and next-token prediction is misaligned with human learning.
yejin.zh: 预训练带来广博知识，但基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）的后训练对安全、友好的回应至关重要；仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）未必能解决常识问题，下一个词预测的预训练目标与人类学习根本错位。

yejin.en: Inference-time algorithms and high-quality synthetic data can let smaller models match larger ones, so alternative solutions using less compute likely exist.
yejin.zh: 推理阶段的算法与高质量合成数据能让更小的模型比肩大模型，因此很可能存在使用更少算力的替代方案。

yejin.en: Data is the fundamental bottleneck; current AI interpolates human knowledge rather than transcending it, and RLVR can hurt pass@k even as best-of-n improves.
yejin.zh: 数据是根本瓶颈；当前 AI 只是对人类知识做插值而非超越，且 RLVR 可能在 best-of-n 提升的同时反而降低 pass@k。

yejin.en: Open research and cross-institution collaboration are crucial to democratize AI and compete with closed frontier labs; Chinese companies now lead open-source contributions.
yejin.zh: 开放研究与跨机构协作对 AI 民主化、并与封闭的前沿模型实验室竞争至关重要；如今中国公司在开源贡献上已处于领先。

yejin.en: Small language models with diverse synthetic data and pluralistic alignment can outperform larger ones; RL as a pre-training objective yields lasting reasoning gains.
yejin.zh: 拥有多样化合成数据与多元对齐的小语言模型可以超越更大的模型；将强化学习作为预训练目标能带来持久的推理提升。

shazeer.en: LLMs solve next-token prediction, an AI-complete problem; Scaling with more compute and data yields smarter AI, though internals remain alchemy.
shazeer.zh: 大语言模型解决的是下一个词预测这一 AI 完全问题；靠更多算力与数据的 Scaling 让 AI 更聪明，但内部机制仍像炼金术。

shazeer.en: Dialogue is the killer app, but the best LLM applications are unforeseen; big tech's brand-risk caution slows launches.
shazeer.zh: 对话是杀手级应用，但大语言模型最好的应用往往出乎创造者预料；大厂因品牌风险与安全顾虑而拖慢发布。

shazeer.en: Inference-time compute scaling and much longer context windows are the near-term opportunity; modular sparse architectures like mixture of experts enable efficient scaling.
shazeer.zh: 推理时算力扩展与更长的上下文窗口是近期机会；混合专家等模块化稀疏架构实现高效 Scaling。

shazeer.en: Models should learn by acting in the world, not passively observing; continual learning with independently trainable modules could replace monolithic retraining.
shazeer.zh: 模型应通过在世界上采取行动来学习，而非被动观察；用可独立训练的模块做持续学习，可能取代单体式重训。

shazeer.en: Test-time compute won't alone reach AGI; agentic behavior, reinforcement learning, and coding matter, and AGI's economic impact is underhyped.
shazeer.zh: 仅靠测试时算力无法达到 AGI；智能体式行为、强化学习与编程至关重要，而 AGI 的经济影响被低估。

leike.en: AI safety is under-explored; talent gap exceeds funding gap. Build skills, don't fear capability research. Alignment and robustness need empirical work.
leike.zh: 2018 年，他认为 AI 安全研究严重不足，人才缺口大于资金缺口；建议先积累技能，不必过度担心参与能力研究；对齐与鲁棒性需要实证研究。

leike.en: RLHF won't scale to superhuman outputs. Need scalable oversight, interpretability, automated alignment research. Evaluation easier than generation.
leike.zh: 2023 年，他转向认为基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）无法扩展到超级智能输出，需要可扩展监督、可解释性和自动化对齐研究；评估比生成更容易。

leike.en: OpenAI safety culture eroded; superalignment team dissolved, compute promises broken. Post-training alone insufficient. Third-party testing and regulation needed.
leike.zh: 2024 年，他批评 OpenAI 安全文化退化，超级对齐团队解散、算力承诺未兑现；仅靠后训练无法解决 AGI 对齐，需要第三方测试和监管。

leike.en: Alignment is tractable if we measure progress empirically. Interpretability and scalable oversight are key. Uncertainty about alignment is the biggest risk.
leike.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：对齐可通过实证测量取得进展，可解释性与可扩展监督是关键，最大的风险是对系统是否真正对齐的不确定性。

truell.en: Scaling laws still predict progress, but test-time compute scaling may soon surpass pre-training scaling as the main driver.
truell.zh: 到 2024 年，他仍相信缩放定律能预测进步，但认为测试时算力扩张可能很快超越预训练扩张，成为 AI 进步的主要驱动力。

truell.en: Agents are promising but not yet super useful; iterative human-AI collaboration stays central, and natural language won't be the primary way to program.
truell.zh: 2024 年他强调智能体虽有前景但尚不实用，迭代式人机协作仍是核心，自然语言不会成为编程的主要方式。

truell.en: The editor is becoming an AI-integrated environment; custom models, not just frontier models, power every magic moment in Cursor.
truell.zh: 从 2024 到 2025 年，他的判断深化为：代码编辑器正演变为 AI 集成环境，而 Cursor 每个神奇时刻都依赖自研定制模型，而非仅靠前沿模型。

truell.en: Programming will move from code to higher-level intent specification, with humans in the driver's seat and taste more valuable than carefulness.
truell.zh: 到 2025 年，他进一步主张编程将从写代码转向更高层的意图指定，人类仍掌握方向盘，品味与逻辑设计比谨慎更值钱。

truell.en: The AI shift will be more consequential than the internet and take decades; incumbents may struggle in a market not friendly to them.
truell.zh: 2025 年他给出更宏观的判断：AI 变革比互联网更具颠覆性、将持续数十年，而现有巨头可能在一个对其不友好的市场中陷入困境。

abbeel.en: Robotics needs hierarchical reasoning for long-horizon credit assignment; current RL lacks it, but self-play and imitation learning provide strong signal.
abbeel.zh: 2018 年，他强调机器人需要分层推理来完成长时程信用分配，而当前强化学习缺乏这一点；但自对弈与模仿学习能提供强学习信号。

abbeel.en: Unsupervised learning plus RL improves sample efficiency; prior knowledge should augment data, not be hard-coded; 99.9% reliability is the warehouse benchmark.
abbeel.zh: 2021 年，他转向无监督学习与强化学习结合以提升样本效率；先验知识应用于数据增强而非硬编码；仓库机器人需达到 99.9% 可靠性才有真实价值。

abbeel.en: Pre-trained language models internalize general reasoning patterns that transfer to non-language tasks like image classification and protein binding prediction.
abbeel.zh: 2021 年，他提出预训练语言模型内化了通用推理模式，可迁移到图像分类和蛋白质结合预测等非语言任务。

abbeel.en: Transfer learning via fine-tuning large pre-trained models is a major AI success; generality of the human brain inspires AI, though current AI is far less general.
abbeel.zh: 贯穿始终：通过微调大型预训练模型进行迁移学习是 AI 的重大成功；人脑的通用性启发 AI 研究，但当前 AI 远不如人脑通用。
